Motivated by the trimerized phases observed in LiVS$_2$ and LiVO$_2$, we consider a triangular-lattice three-orbital system with two electrons per site occupying the threefold-degenerate $t_{2g}$ manifold. Starting from a multiorbital Kanamori-Hubbard Hamiltonian, we project the low-energy sector onto the local $S=1$ triplet manifold, in which two electrons occupy different orbitals according to Hund's coupling. The resulting effective model exhibits exchange networks whose geometry is determined by the orbital configuration. However, the orbital-driven exchange interactions alone do not stabilize the experimentally observed trimer phase. We find that by incorporating ionic lattice displacements that modulate transfer integrals and induce bond-dependent exchange couplings on shortened and elongated bonds, the phase competition is qualitatively altered, leading to the robust stabilization of a trimerized ground state within a fully quantum-mechanical framework. We further show that a simplified orbital-lattice model, in which the spin-exchange energy is replaced by effective bond energies, faithfully reproduces the essential ground-state properties of the microscopic model. This reduced description enables large-scale finite-temperature simulations and reveals a rich sequence of thermal phase transitions, including first-order, second-order, and Kosterlitz-Thouless transitions into distinct spin-, orbital-, and lattice-ordered phases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“derive an effective model”“project the low-energy sector”“show that”等理论推导和模型构建关键词，未提及实验或计算模拟手段。；研究对象：轨道简并过渡金属化合物中的团簇化（clusterization）现象，具体以LiVS₂和LiVO₂中观察到的三聚化（trimerized）相为动机，研究三角晶格三轨道系统（每个格点两个电子占据三重简并t₂g轨道）中自旋、轨道和晶格自由度协同作用导致的团簇形成。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 仅靠轨道驱动的交换相互作用无法稳定实验观测到的三聚化相；引入离子晶格位移（调制跃迁积分并产生键依赖的交换耦合）后，相竞争被定性改变，从而在全量子力学框架下稳健地稳定了三聚化基态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：仅靠轨道驱动的交换相互作用无法稳定实验观测到的三聚化相；引入离子晶格位移（调制跃迁积分并产生键依赖的交换耦合）后，相竞争被定性改变，从而在全量子力学框架下稳健地稳定了三聚化基态。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 从多轨道Kanamori-Hubbard哈密顿量出发，将低能部分投影到局域S=1三重态流形（两个电子根据洪德耦合占据不同轨道），推导出有效轨道-晶格模型；进一步简化得到用有效键能替代自旋交换能的轨道-晶格模型，用于大规模有限温度模拟。

papers.title: Thermodynamic description of wealth inequality in the world
papers.abstract: According to the recent Wealth Thermalization Hypothesis (WTH) the wealth inequality in the world is described by the Rayleigh-Jeans (RJ) thermal distribution of interacting agents in a society with social stratification. In this concept, the wealth layers of society are associated with energy levels from a nonlinear dynamical system conserving two integrals of motion being total energy and probability norm. This leads to RJ condensation and the formation of a huge poverty phase of low wealth and a tiny oligarchic phase that captures a main part of total society wealth. This RJ phenomenon has similarities with self cleaning in multimode optical fibers and constraint driven condensation in various physical systems. We analyze real Lorenz and Pareto curves for wealth of households in countries and the world, Gross Domestic Product of countries, market capitalization of companies at stock exchange of Hong Kong, Shanghai, London, bitcoin transactions, world trade between countries and show that the WTH theory gives a good description of these curves. On the basis of this comparison we argue that the RJ thermal distribution provides a universal description of wealth inequality in the world.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Wealth Thermalization Hypothesis (WTH)、Rayleigh-Jeans thermal distribution、理论描述。；研究对象：全球财富不平等现象，具体包括国家及家庭财富、国内生产总值、公司市值、比特币交易、国际贸易等社会经济体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 财富热化假说（WTH）提出的瑞利-金斯（RJ）热分布能够普适地描述全球财富不平等，表现为大量低财富贫困相与少数寡头相（占据大部分社会财富）的RJ凝聚现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：财富热化假说（WTH）提出的瑞利-金斯（RJ）热分布能够普适地描述全球财富不平等，表现为大量低财富贫困相与少数寡头相（占据大部分社会财富）的RJ凝聚现象。；创新点：将凝聚态物理中的瑞利-金斯凝聚（如多模光纤自清洁、约束驱动凝聚）概念引入社会经济系统，提出财富不平等具有与物理系统相似的普适热力学描述。
papers.method_zh: 采用非线性动力学系统中的能量层模型（守恒总能量与概率范数），将社会财富分层类比为能级，并基于瑞利-金斯热分布理论分析实际洛伦兹曲线和帕累托曲线。

papers.title: Revisiting quantum effects on dislocation glide in bcc metals from DFT calculations and machine-learning potentials
papers.abstract: Quantum zero-point effects have been long proposed to explain a well-known discrepancy between the low-temperature flow stresses of body-centered cubic metals and corresponding atomistic models of plastic flow. Previous investigations on quantum effects relied on empirical interatomic potentials, which poorly reproduce dislocation energy landscapes compared to density functional theory (DFT) calculations. Here, we revisit this problem using DFT and machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs). We show that while quantum effects do contribute to dislocation glide at low temperature, their magnitude is much lower than previously reported, and insufficient to reconcile atomistic predictions with experiments. Our results thus reopen a long-standing question and challenge for predictive atomistic modeling, on a fundamental property of crystals.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：DFT calculations、machine-learning potentials、atomistic modeling）；研究对象：体心立方（bcc）金属中位错滑移的量子效应，具体涉及低温流动应力与原子模型之间的长期差异。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 量子零点效应对低温位错滑移确有贡献，但其幅度远低于先前基于经验势的报道，不足以解释原子模型预测与实验之间的差异，从而重新提出了这一长期未解的问题。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：量子零点效应对低温位错滑移确有贡献，但其幅度远低于先前基于经验势的报道，不足以解释原子模型预测与实验之间的差异，从而重新提出了这一长期未解的问题。；创新点：首次使用DFT和MLIPs（而非精度较低的经验势）重新评估量子效应对bcc金属位错滑移的影响，揭示了先前研究高估了量子效应的贡献。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论（DFT）计算与机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）相结合。

papers.title: Torsion-controlled spin transport and tunable intersubband absorption in a screw-dislocated semiconductor nanowire
papers.abstract: We develop an effective-mass theory for spin-resolved transport and intersubband optical absorption in a finite semiconductor nanowire containing a uniform screw-dislocation-induced torsion. The central transport quantity is the band bottom of each torsion-dependent one-dimensional subband: torsion lowers this band bottom while an axial magnetic field resolves the two Zeeman branches, so that a spin-selective torsion interval opens when the Fermi level lies between the two branch minima. We distinguish this band-bottom transport threshold from the fixed-momentum transverse energy that governs the vertical intersubband optical transition, and obtain a design rule for the width of the spin-selective torsion interval that is linear in the Zeeman splitting in the small-splitting limit. Finite-size effects are incorporated by treating the active region as an open scattering region of length $L$ and radius $R$, with Fabry-Perot interference, radial boundary conditions, and surface-induced linewidth broadening. The spin-resolved response remains well defined when the effective linewidth satisfies $Γ_{\mathrm{eff}}\llΔ_Z$, a criterion quantified through polarization and conductance-contrast maps. In the optical sector, finite-radius intersubband absorption gives a torsion-tunable resonance in the THz range; surface boundary conditions shift the absolute resonance frequency and modify the oscillator strength, while, for the dominant unit-branch transition, the leading fixed-momentum torsional slope $\partialω/\partialτ\simeq\hbar k_F/m^*$ is preserved. The resulting framework connects geometric torsion, spin-resolved mesoscopic transport, spin thermopower, and tunable intersubband absorption within a single open-quantum-wire model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：effective-mass theory（有效质量理论）、open-quantum-wire model（开放量子线模型）。；研究对象：含均匀螺旋位错诱导扭转的有限半导体纳米线中的自旋分辨输运和子带间光吸收。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 扭转可以降低一维子带的带底，而轴向磁场分裂塞曼分支，从而在费米能级位于两分支极小值之间时产生自旋选择性的扭转能隙；子带间光吸收的共振频率可通过扭转在太赫兹范围内调谐。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：扭转可以降低一维子带的带底，而轴向磁场分裂塞曼分支，从而在费米能级位于两分支极小值之间时产生自旋选择性的扭转能隙；子带间光吸收的共振频率可通过扭转在太赫兹范围内调谐。；创新点：将几何扭转、自旋分辨介观输运、自旋热电势和可调子带间吸收统一在一个开放量子线模型中，并给出了小塞曼分裂极限下自旋选择性扭转能隙宽度与塞曼分裂的线性设计规则。
papers.method_zh: 基于有效质量理论，构建了包含扭转、轴向磁场、有限尺寸效应（法布里-珀罗干涉、径向边界条件、表面诱导线宽展宽）的开放量子线模型，并通过极化率和电导对比图量化了自旋分辨响应的有效性判据（Γ_eff ≪ Δ_Z）。

papers.title: Three-dimensional repulsive Hubbard model
papers.abstract: The three-dimensional repulsive Hubbard model is investigated using the strong-coupling diagram technique. For half-filling, the boundary between paramagnetic and antiferromagnetic states is determined for the range of the Hubbard repulsion $4t\leq U\leq12t$, where $t$ is the hopping integral between neighboring sites. Along this boundary, the density of states is calculated, and it demonstrates the Mott transition at $U\approx9t$. For $U\geq6t$ and half-filling, the density of states has the shape inherent in the strong electron repulsion, while for $U=4t$, its shape points to weak coupling. The dependence of the Néel temperature $T_{\rm N}$ on the electron concentration $\bar{n}$ is investigated for the cases $U=4t$ and $12t$. In the former case, $T_{\rm N}$ decreases monotonously with $\bar{n}$, while in the latter case, there is a plateau in the dependence near $\bar{n}=0.87$. The plateau is connected to a reconstruction of the density of states caused by an effective weakening of electron coupling due to electron depopulation. For $U=12t$ and half-filling, the magnetic critical exponent $γ\approx1.4$, which is close to the value in the Heisenberg model. Some features resembling the first-order phase transition, revealing themselves in a finite crystal, are discussed.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：strong-coupling diagram technique（强耦合图解法）、计算、理论分析。；研究对象：三维排斥型哈伯德模型（three-dimensional repulsive Hubbard model），具体研究其在不同电子浓度和哈伯德排斥强度下的磁性与金属-绝缘体相变行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在半填充条件下，确定了顺磁态与反铁磁态之间的边界，并在U≈9t处观察到莫特转变；对于U=12t，奈尔温度随电子浓度的依赖关系在约0.87浓度附近出现平台，该平台与电子退占据导致的态密度重构有关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在半填充条件下，确定了顺磁态与反铁磁态之间的边界，并在U≈9t处观察到莫特转变；对于U=12t，奈尔温度随电子浓度的依赖关系在约0.87浓度附近出现平台，该平台与电子退占据导致的态密度重构有关。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有研究的具体差异，但指出在U=12t时奈尔温度随电子浓度依赖关系中出现平台，并讨论了有限晶体中类似一级相变的特征。
papers.method_zh: 采用强耦合图解法（strong-coupling diagram technique）对三维排斥型哈伯德模型进行理论计算，分析了态密度、奈尔温度、磁临界指数等物理量。

papers.title: Hydrogen s-electrons as the origin of crystal magnetism beyond spin-orbit coupling
papers.abstract: Magnetism has long been attributed to localized d, f, and even p electrons with strong correlations, whereas s electrons exemplified by hydrogen are reactive and tend to have their spins quenched, making s-electron-derived magnetism and long-range ordered magnetic crystals seem unattainable. Here we report a low-Z ferromagnetic crystal H13@(BN)12 using first-principles calculations, where thirteen hydrogen atoms are encapsulated within a (BN)12 cage and magnetism originates from the 1s electron of the central hydrogen atom. The crystal remains stable under ambient pressure owing to chemical precompression. Notably, the central hydrogen atom retains a magnetic moment of 1 μB, with long-range magnetic order established through multicenter bonding within the H13 aggregate and the intercell B-B network, while the zero orbital angular momentum of s electrons renders spin-orbit coupling (SOC) negligible as expected. Electronic structure analyses reveal that the large cavity and central negative electrostatic potential of the (BN)12 cage localize the hydrogen 1s electron, preventing spin quenching. Interestingly, under 16 GPa compression, the system transforms into a nonmagnetic metallic state driven by delocalized electrons of the central hydrogen atom. This study opens a pathway for constructing s-electron-driven magnetic materials and lays the foundation for developing low-energy consumption magnetic devices without SOC.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“first-principles calculations”（第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：一种低原子序数（low-Z）的铁磁晶体 H13@(BN)12，即由13个氢原子封装在(BN)12笼内形成的体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该晶体的磁性来源于中心氢原子的1s电子，且通过多中心键和晶胞间B-B网络建立了长程磁有序，实现了无需自旋-轨道耦合（SOC）的s电子驱动磁性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该晶体的磁性来源于中心氢原子的1s电子，且通过多中心键和晶胞间B-B网络建立了长程磁有序，实现了无需自旋-轨道耦合（SOC）的s电子驱动磁性。；创新点：首次提出并证明了s电子（氢1s电子）可以在无自旋-轨道耦合的情况下驱动长程磁有序，打破了传统认为磁性必须依赖d、f或p电子且s电子自旋易淬灭的认知。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations），具体包括电子结构分析（electronic structure analyses）以研究局域化与自旋淬灭机制，以及施加16 GPa压力下的结构相变模拟。

papers.title: Influence of Ultramicroporosity and Surface Chemistry on Dynamic CO2 Capture in Activated Carbons
papers.abstract: Activated carbons are promising adsorbents for post-combustion CO2 capture due to their high surface area, tunable microporosity, and resistance to moisture and flue-gas impurities. Despite extensive equilibrium adsorption studies, the dynamic behavior of activated carbons under fixed-bed operating conditions relevant to post-combustion CO2/N2 remains insufficiently understood, particularly for renewable materials. In this work, the adsorption and separation behavior of CO2/N2 mixtures on a commercial coal-derived activated carbon (WS-480) and a biomass-based activated carbon (MSP700-A900CO2) is comparatively evaluated by combining experimental measurements and simulations. We examine the physicochemical properties of both materials, revealing that although WS-480 exhibits a higher of porosity, MSP700-A900CO2 contains a larger fraction of ultramicropores (<0.7 nm) and a broader distribution of oxygen-containing functional groups. These characteristics result in higher CO2 adsorption capacities for MSP700-A900CO2 in fixed-bed breakthrough experiments conducted under varying flow rates, temperatures and CO2 concentrations. We employ atomistic activated carbon models, augmented with surface functional groups as representations of WS-480 and MSP700-A900CO2, achieving close agreement with experimental adsorption data. The validated models are subsequently used to predict CO2/N2 separation under equilibrium and dynamic conditions, reproducing the experimental breakthrough behavior while providing molecular-level insight into the influence of pore structure and surface chemistry on adsorption performance.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。关键词：experimental measurements, simulations, atomistic activated carbon models。；研究对象：两种活性炭材料：商业煤基活性炭（WS-480）和生物质基活性炭（MSP700-A900CO2），用于动态CO2捕集。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 尽管WS-480总孔隙率更高，但MSP700-A900CO2含有更多超微孔（<0.7 nm）和更广泛的含氧官能团分布，使其在固定床穿透实验中表现出更高的CO2吸附容量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：尽管WS-480总孔隙率更高，但MSP700-A900CO2含有更多超微孔（<0.7 nm）和更广泛的含氧官能团分布，使其在固定床穿透实验中表现出更高的CO2吸附容量。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段：固定床穿透实验（不同流速、温度、CO2浓度）、理化性质表征。计算方法：原子级活性炭模型（含表面官能团）进行分子模拟，用于预测平衡和动态条件下的CO2/N2分离行为。

papers.title: Finite and disordered Kitaev chains: a large deviation study
papers.abstract: Topological edge states are celebrated for their robustness against disorder, yet the interplay between disorder and system size remains poorly understood. We use large deviations theory as a framework to study finite-size effects beyond the central limit theorem. We analyze Lyapunov exponent fluctuations in the static and periodically driven disordered Kitaev chain and find an asymmetry in the large deviations statistics that makes stronger edge localizations of Majorana zero modes exponentially more likely than weaker ones. We demonstrate that this fluctuation asymmetry is not tied to the topological phase. This asymmetry endows topological edge states with an additional protection against disorder and persists across a broad class of disorder distribution. We show how to use our framework to find the minimum system size required to satisfy topological quantum computing constraints.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：large deviations theory（大偏差理论）、Lyapunov exponent fluctuations（李雅普诺夫指数涨落）、分析（analyze）。；研究对象：无序Kitaev链（静态和周期驱动情况），具体研究其中马约拉纳零模的边缘态局域化行为及有限尺寸效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 无序Kitaev链中李雅普诺夫指数的涨落存在不对称性，使得马约拉纳零模的强边缘局域化比弱局域化在指数上更可能发生；这种不对称性不依赖于拓扑相，为拓扑边缘态提供了额外的抗无序保护。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：无序Kitaev链中李雅普诺夫指数的涨落存在不对称性，使得马约拉纳零模的强边缘局域化比弱局域化在指数上更可能发生；这种不对称性不依赖于拓扑相，为拓扑边缘态提供了额外的抗无序保护。；创新点：利用大偏差理论超越中心极限定理，系统研究有限尺寸效应，并揭示了涨落不对称性对拓扑边缘态的保护作用；同时展示了如何利用该框架确定满足拓扑量子计算约束所需的最小系统尺寸。
papers.method_zh: 采用大偏差理论作为理论框架，分析静态和周期驱动无序Kitaev链中李雅普诺夫指数的涨落统计，并研究不同无序分布下的行为。

papers.title: Robust Signatures of Fragile Topology
papers.abstract: Some topological phases of matter are called fragile. They do not generically host protected gapless boundary states and they can be trivialized by adding additional valence bands. Here we show that fragile topology nevertheless has robust signatures: it yields bulk Dirac cones in two-dimensional materials with arbitrarily many bands. In systems with time-reversal and twofold rotation symmetry, we establish a fragile topological index which guarantees the presence of gap closing points in the band structure. We test this prediction using first-principles calculations in five materials and find that all of them host such Dirac points, suggesting that this is a widespread phenomenon. Our results provide a robust spectroscopic signature of fragile topology which can be directly accessed in experiment. Further, they enable an alternate method for finding Dirac cones in ab-initio simulations, and may be used as a route towards identifying materials with nonlinear transport properties.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有第一性原理计算验证）。判断依据：建立拓扑指标、理论分析、first-principles calculations。；研究对象：脆性拓扑相（fragile topology）在二维材料中的鲁棒性光谱特征，具体为受时间反演和二次旋转对称性保护的体态狄拉克锥。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 脆性拓扑相虽然通常被认为没有受保护的边界态，但依然具有鲁棒的光谱特征：在具有时间反演和二次旋转对称性的二维材料中，脆性拓扑指标保证能带结构中存在狄拉克锥（能隙闭合点），且这一现象在多种材料中普遍存在。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：脆性拓扑相虽然通常被认为没有受保护的边界态，但依然具有鲁棒的光谱特征：在具有时间反演和二次旋转对称性的二维材料中，脆性拓扑指标保证能带结构中存在狄拉克锥（能隙闭合点），且这一现象在多种材料中普遍存在。；创新点：首次证明脆性拓扑相具有可直接实验观测的鲁棒光谱特征（体态狄拉克锥），并提供了通过脆性拓扑指标在ab-initio模拟中寻找狄拉克锥的新方法，为识别具有非线性输运性质的材料提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导脆性拓扑指标（fragile topological index），并结合第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）在五种材料中进行验证。

papers.title: Replica theory for the rate functional of the empirical spectral distribution function of diluted Hermitian matrices
papers.abstract: We develop a replica-based framework for the scaled cumulant-generating functional of the empirical spectral distribution function $i_C$ of diluted Hermitian random matrices. Within a replica-symmetric saddle-point assumption, this construction yields a candidate rate functional for fluctuations of $i_C$. As an illustrative application, we consider adjacency matrices of unweighted Erdős-Rényi random graphs with mean degree $c$. We derive explicit expressions for the first two cumulants of $i_C$, indicate how higher cumulants can be obtained from further functional derivatives, and compute the rate function of Fourier coefficients, equivalently of selected linear spectral statistics. The replica-symmetric predictions are tested against exact numerical diagonalization and show good agreement in the accessible fluctuation regime. The approach provides a basis for studying rate functionals of spectral observables in sparse random matrix ensembles.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“replica-based framework”、“replica-symmetric saddle-point assumption”、“derive explicit expressions”。；研究对象：稀释厄米随机矩阵的经验谱分布函数的率泛函，具体以未加权 Erdős-Rényi 随机图的邻接矩阵（平均度 c）为例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在复制对称鞍点假设下，构建了稀释厄米随机矩阵经验谱分布函数涨落的候选率泛函，并推导了其前两个累积量的显式表达式，该复制对称预测与精确数值对角化在可访问的涨落区间内吻合良好。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在复制对称鞍点假设下，构建了稀释厄米随机矩阵经验谱分布函数涨落的候选率泛函，并推导了其前两个累积量的显式表达式，该复制对称预测与精确数值对角化在可访问的涨落区间内吻合良好。；创新点：为稀疏随机矩阵系综中谱观测量的率泛函研究提供了基础框架，并首次在稀释厄米矩阵中显式推导了经验谱分布函数的累积量及傅里叶系数的率函数。
papers.method_zh: 基于复制理论（replica theory）的框架，用于计算经验谱分布函数的标度累积生成泛函；通过复制对称鞍点假设得到候选率泛函；利用泛函导数计算高阶累积量；通过精确数值对角化验证理论预测。

papers.title: Chirality-induced spin selectivity without intrinsic spin-orbit coupling: Role of current-induced molecular orbital moment
papers.abstract: The microscopic origin of the chirality-induced spin selectivity (CISS) in helical molecules remains an open question. Recent experiments suggest that a significant contribution to CISS arises from the molecule itself, which is disregarded in existing interfacial or scattering based theories. Here we present an alternative theory of CISS to address this molecular contribution. The mechanism is based on the circulation of charge current in molecular loops that generates a molecular orbital moment (MOM). The direction of the MOM is governed by the gauge field arising from the structural distortion of the molecule and is associated with the handedness of the molecule. Such a MOM can produce finite CISS magnetoresistance and magnetochiral conductance asymmetries that are even in bias voltage, without violating the Onsager-Casimir reciprocity relations. Depending on the Fermi level and bias voltage, the MOM can be controlled externally, which can result in additional crossings of the enantiomer $I-V$ curves. Finally we explain the origin of the electrical magnetochiral anisotropy within the same framework, which establishes its generic applicability.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“present an alternative theory”、“mechanism”、“framework”。；研究对象：手性分子中的手性诱导自旋选择性（CISS）效应，具体关注分子本身对CISS的贡献。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种不依赖本征自旋-轨道耦合的CISS机制：分子中电荷电流在分子环中循环产生分子轨道矩（MOM），该MOM的方向由分子结构畸变产生的规范场决定，并与分子手性相关联，从而产生有限的自旋选择性磁电阻和磁手性电导不对称性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种不依赖本征自旋-轨道耦合的CISS机制：分子中电荷电流在分子环中循环产生分子轨道矩（MOM），该MOM的方向由分子结构畸变产生的规范场决定，并与分子手性相关联，从而产生有限的自旋选择性磁电阻和磁手性电导不对称性。；创新点：区别于现有基于界面或散射的理论，该工作首次从分子自身电流循环产生的轨道矩出发解释CISS，且不依赖本征自旋-轨道耦合，并统一解释了电学磁手性各向异性的起源。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导。基于分子轨道矩（MOM）的物理图像，结合规范场理论分析结构畸变的影响，并利用Onsager-Casimir互易关系验证结果的合理性。

papers.title: Higher-order topological metasurface based on split-ring resonators with dipole-quadrupole couplings
papers.abstract: Photonic higher-order topological insulators (HOTI) are characterized by a hierarchy of topologically-protected states with different dimensionalities, making them especially interesting for potential applications that combine strong localization of electromagnetic fields and their robust waveguiding. However, their practical implementation often requires expensive processing techniques and is limited by accessible material parameters. In this paper, we demonstrate that a radio-frequency photonic HOTI can be implemented as a metasurface composed of split-ring resonators with couplings between dipole and quadrupole modes. We verify, by numerical simulations and experimentally at frequencies of 1.5-1.7 GHz, that a proposed metasurface supports corner- and edge-localized states. Our results reveal a scalable and easily reconfigurable GHz-range platform that employs printed circuit board technology, thus making crucial steps required for further experimental studies of photonic HOTI and the development of their microwave applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+数值模拟）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“numerical simulations and experimentally”。；研究对象：基于开口谐振环（split-ring resonators）的射频光子高阶拓扑绝缘体（HOTI）超表面，其耦合机制为偶极-四极模式耦合。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该超表面在1.5-1.7 GHz频段内支持角态和边缘态，验证了高阶拓扑绝缘体的层级拓扑保护态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该超表面在1.5-1.7 GHz频段内支持角态和边缘态，验证了高阶拓扑绝缘体的层级拓扑保护态。；创新点：利用偶极-四极耦合的开口谐振环构建可扩展、易重构的GHz频段超表面平台，避免了昂贵加工工艺和材料参数限制，为光子HOTI的微波应用提供了实用化途径。
papers.method_zh: 数值模拟（具体方法未明确说明）与实验测量（频率1.5-1.7 GHz，采用印刷电路板技术制备样品）。

papers.title: Nonlinear Optical Probing of Ferroic-Octupolar Order Parameter in Collinear Altermagnet
papers.abstract: Altermagnetism as a new concept in condensed matter physics is currently being thoroughly investigated. Despite the absence of macroscopic magnetization, altermagnets host a hidden spin order whose direct detection remains a challenge. Here we report on the observation of electric and magnetic dipole forbidden optical second-harmonic generation (SHG) in the altermagnet CoF$_2$ with a centrosymmetric lattice and spin order. We demonstrate that below the Néel temperature $T_N = 38$ K the SHG signal is sensitive to the ferrotype magnetic octupole $\mathbf{\mathcal{O}}^M$ which is the order parameter in the antiferromagnetic phase. By combining polarization-resolved SHG experimental data and a phenomenological symmetry analysis, we show that the altermagnetic spin structure of CoF$_2$ enables a ferroic-octupole-induced electric-quadrupolar nonlinear polarization $\mathbf{P}^{2ω} = \mathrm i\varepsilon_{0}{ }^c\mathbfχ^{(3)}(\mathbf{\mathcal{O}}^M) :\mathbf{E}^ω \nabla \mathbf{E}^ω$. The temperature dependence of SHG reveals a phase transition at $T_N$ confirming the spin origin of the observed signal. The SHG response is resonantly enhanced by a coherent three-photon process caused by the electronic $d$-$d$ transitions of the Co$^{2+}$ ion. Model calculations of SHG polarization rotational anisotropies and temperature dependencies give a reasonable agreement with experimental data, proving the disclosed nonlinear contribution. Our results establish SHG as a novel sensitive tool of ferroic-octupolar spin ordering and highlight the potential of CoF$_2$ and other altermagnets for further nonlinear optical investigations and applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：observation, experimental data, polarization-resolved SHG experimental data, model calculations）；研究对象：反铁磁体CoF₂中的交变磁（altermagnet）自旋结构及其铁性八极矩（ferroic-octupolar）序参量。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在中心对称晶格且具有自旋有序的交变磁体CoF₂中，观测到了电偶极和磁偶极禁戒的光学二次谐波产生（SHG），该信号对铁性磁八极矩敏感，证实了SHG可作为探测铁性八极自旋有序的新型灵敏工具。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在中心对称晶格且具有自旋有序的交变磁体CoF₂中，观测到了电偶极和磁偶极禁戒的光学二次谐波产生（SHG），该信号对铁性磁八极矩敏感，证实了SHG可作为探测铁性八极自旋有序的新型灵敏工具。；创新点：首次利用SHG直接探测了交变磁体中隐藏的、无宏观磁化的铁性八极自旋序参量，并揭示了其通过电四极非线性极化机制产生SHG的物理过程。
papers.method_zh: 偏振分辨的二次谐波产生（SHG）实验，结合唯象对称性分析，以及基于Co²⁺离子电子d-d跃迁的三光子共振增强过程的模型计算。

papers.title: The antiferromagnetic transition in the frustrated bixbyite $β$-Fe$_2$O$_3$ magnet
papers.abstract: Although Fe$_2$O$_3$ compounds are among the most extensively studied transition-metal oxides, the magnetic properties of $β$-Fe$_2$O$_3$ remain poorly characterized. Using neutron and synchrotron X-ray diffraction, we investigate the temperature-driven magnetic transition in $β$-Fe$_2$O$_3$. A noncollinear antiferromagnetic structure sets in abruptly via activation of irrep $mH_1^{+}$ at the H-point [$\mathbf{k}=(1,1,1)$] together with antitranslation $(1'|\tfrac{1}{2},\tfrac{1}{2},\tfrac{1}{2})$. Below $T_{\mathrm{N}}$, the magnetic cell becomes primitive $(P_I a \bar{3})$, yielding two interpenetrating primitive cubic subcells with inverted moments and non-polar type-IV symmetry. All Fe$^{3+}$-O-Fe$^{3+}$ exchanges are antiferromagnetic, and the bixbyite structure promotes geometric frustration and noncollinear magnetism through coexisting magnetic sublattices with distinct symmetries and easy axes. Its frustration index $f \simeq 7.6$ is among the highest reported for binary magnetic oxides. In $\{111\}$ planes, distorted Fe2O$_6$ octahedra form hexagonal rings interconnected by triangular units. Notably, hexagonal Fe2 rings host a central Fe1 ion with strong Ising-like anisotropy, which could act as a switching element for the rings' magnetic state. These features point to routes for functional design.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：使用中子衍射和同步辐射X射线衍射进行实验研究。；研究对象：β-Fe₂O₃（一种bixbyite结构的铁氧化物）中的反铁磁相变及其磁结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: β-Fe₂O₃在低温下通过激活H点（k=(1,1,1)）的不可约表示mH₁⁺和反平移操作，突然形成非共线反铁磁序，其磁挫败指数f≈7.6，是二元磁性氧化物中最高值之一。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：β-Fe₂O₃在低温下通过激活H点（k=(1,1,1)）的不可约表示mH₁⁺和反平移操作，突然形成非共线反铁磁序，其磁挫败指数f≈7.6，是二元磁性氧化物中最高值之一。；创新点：首次详细表征了β-Fe₂O₃的磁结构及其温度驱动相变，揭示了其非共线反铁磁序、高挫败指数以及由Fe2O₆八面体构成的六角环与三角单元共存的独特几何挫败机制，并指出六角环中具有强Ising各向异性的中心Fe1离子可能作为磁态开关元件。
papers.method_zh: 中子衍射、同步辐射X射线衍射；通过不可约表示（irrep）分析磁结构，结合晶体结构对称性分析。

papers.title: Bridging the continuum and the kinetic-Boltzmann theories of heat flow through generalized Knudsen numbers
papers.abstract: Heat conduction in semiconductor crystals is fundamentally governed by the linearized Peierls-Boltzmann equation (LPBE) for phonon transport, that arises out of a kinetic theory for phonon quasiparticles. Yet, continuum theories such as the Fourier's heat diffusion, weakly quasiballistic and hydrodynamic heat equations are often used to explain the experimental observations of heat flow in these materials. Here, we show that a systematic reduction of the LPBE into such equivalent continuum descriptions are possible only for the limiting values of a set of generalized Knudsen numbers. We further show that all of these continuum heat flow regimes, along with the ballistic heat flow, can be described by a single continuum equation for the temperature field that originates from the eigenmode analysis of the LPBE, thus offering a unified picture of all possible heat flow regimes in semiconducting crystals. Using quantitative examples on twenty three technologically important semiconductors, we show that several previously-unidentified features of the non-Fourier heat flow regimes emerge from this generalized Knudsen number framework such as (1) the mutual exclusivity of the weakly quasiballistic and the hydrodynamic heat flow regimes, (2) length-dependent velocity of the hydrodynamic second sound temperature wave and a characteristic heating length for the strongest hydrodynamic second sound, (3) characteristic frequency-domain temperature response distinguishing the hydrodynamic second sound from the ballistic heat flow regime and, (4) a new non-oscillatory signature of transient hydrodynamic heat flow. Our work formally bridges the continuum and the particulate descriptions of heat flow, and provides insights into the important signatures of temperature dynamics in each of these heat flow regimes, that will aid in their unambiguous experimental observations in the future.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“systematic reduction of the LPBE”、“eigenmode analysis”、“generalized Knudsen number framework”等理论推导和建模方法，未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：半导体晶体中的热传导现象，具体涵盖从弹道输运到流体动力学输运等多种热流机制，并以23种技术重要的半导体材料为例进行定量分析。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入一组广义克努森数，可以将线性化Peierls-Boltzmann方程（LPBE）系统地约化为多种连续介质热传导理论（如傅里叶扩散、弱准弹道和流体动力学热方程），并发现所有热流机制（包括弹道热流）可由一个统一的温度场连续方程描述。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入一组广义克努森数，可以将线性化Peierls-Boltzmann方程（LPBE）系统地约化为多种连续介质热传导理论（如傅里叶扩散、弱准弹道和流体动力学热方程），并发现所有热流机制（包括弹道热流）可由一个统一的温度场连续方程描述。；创新点：1. 揭示了弱准弹道热流与流体动力学热流机制的互斥性；2. 发现流体动力学第二声速具有长度依赖性，并定义了最强第二声对应的特征加热长度；3. 给出了区分流体动力学第二声与弹道热流的频域温度响应特征；4. 发现了瞬态流体动力学热流的一种新的非振荡特征。摘要未突出说明与已有理论的具体对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于声子输运的线性化Peierls-Boltzmann方程（LPBE）的本征模分析，引入广义克努森数进行尺度约化，推导出统一的连续介质温度场方程。定量分析：对23种半导体材料进行数值示例计算。

papers.title: Tunneling amplifies chirality-induced spin selectivity and explains its current-direction invariance
papers.abstract: We propose a minimal model for chirality-induced spin selectivity (CISS) in dc transport through insulating chiral molecules, based on quantum tunneling and interaction-induced spin splitting. As a concrete realization of the latter, we consider a weak Zeeman interaction of the particle spin with the current-induced magnetic field, recently shown to occur in helical molecules. We show that quantum tunneling, combined with dissipation, amplifies the effect, so that even such a small spin-dependent perturbation can yield spin polarizations on the order of 100\% across a wide range of applied bias voltages. Furthermore, our tunneling scenario naturally reproduces the characteristic CISS symmetry of the current-voltage dependence -- namely, the invariance of the spin-polarization sign under reversal of the current direction -- while fully respecting Onsager's reciprocity relations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：propose a minimal model、quantum tunneling、interaction-induced spin splitting。；研究对象：手性分子中直流输运过程中的手性诱导自旋选择性（CISS）效应，具体为绝缘手性分子中的量子隧穿与自旋相关相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 量子隧穿结合耗散可以放大微小的自旋依赖微扰（如电流诱导磁场引起的弱塞曼相互作用），从而在宽偏压范围内实现接近100%的自旋极化；该隧穿机制自然复现了CISS中自旋极化符号在电流方向反转时不变的特征，并完全符合昂萨格倒易关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：量子隧穿结合耗散可以放大微小的自旋依赖微扰（如电流诱导磁场引起的弱塞曼相互作用），从而在宽偏压范围内实现接近100%的自旋极化；该隧穿机制自然复现了CISS中自旋极化符号在电流方向反转时不变的特征，并完全符合昂萨格倒易关系。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于量子隧穿和相互作用诱导自旋劈裂的最小模型，具体考虑了螺旋分子中粒子自旋与电流诱导磁场的弱塞曼相互作用。

papers.title: Spin-Wave Phase Shifter Controlled by a Domain Wall Racetrack
papers.abstract: We propose a spin-wave phase shifter controlled using a domain-wall racetrack. The concept is demonstrated using micromagnetic simulations of a Permalloy domain-wall racetrack placed above a YIG film. The stray field from pinned domain walls modifies the internal magnetic field in the YIG region under the racetrack. This leads to a local change of the spin-wave wavelength and thereby enables control of the phase accumulated by Damon-Eshbach spin waves propagating through the region. Moving domain walls on the racetrack, the same physical structure can provide phase shifts of up to +/-90 degrees, without changing the waveguide geometry. A model based on the semiclassical approximation confirms that the phase shift is dominated by the domain-wall-induced stray field. These results suggest a route toward a compact programmable spin-wave phase shifter for interference-based magnonic circuits for information processing. Moreover, the demonstrated magnonic device integration with a magnetic domain-wall racetrack can lead to its application in in-memory computing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（基于微磁模拟和半经典近似模型，未涉及实验制备或测量）。；研究对象：基于磁畴壁赛道（domain-wall racetrack）的自旋波移相器，具体材料体系为坡莫合金（Permalloy）赛道置于钇铁石榴石（YIG）薄膜上方。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过移动赛道上的磁畴壁，利用其杂散场局部改变YIG中自旋波的波长，可实现高达±90度的相位调控，且不改变波导几何结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过移动赛道上的磁畴壁，利用其杂散场局部改变YIG中自旋波的波长，可实现高达±90度的相位调控，且不改变波导几何结构。；创新点：提出将磁畴壁赛道与自旋波器件集成，实现紧凑、可编程的自旋波移相器，为基于干涉的磁子电路和存内计算提供新路径。
papers.method_zh: 微磁模拟（micromagnetic simulations）用于演示移相器概念；半经典近似模型（semiclassical approximation）用于验证相位偏移主要由畴壁杂散场主导。

papers.title: Electronic access to glass transition in supercooled ionic liquids using ambipolar transistor
papers.abstract: Relaxation dynamics of supercooled liquids approaching glassy arrest remain a central challenge in integrated electronic architectures, where conventional rheometry becomes incompatible. Here, we demonstrate that an ambipolar PdSe$_2$ field-effect transistor functions as an electrical probe capable of resolving ion-specific relaxation dynamics in fragile ionic glass formers and semiquantitatively inferring rheological parameters within an operating device environment. Temperature evolution of the transfer curve hysteresis and time-resolved current transients under ionic-gate pulse reveal a non-Arrhenius fragile slowdown. We track the continuous reduction of dynamically equilibrated liquid regions approaching the glass transition through an electrically accessible quantity $p_\text{eq}(T)$, quantifying the fraction of the mobile ions able to relax within the experimental timescale. Upon cooling, $p_\text{eq}$ collapses sharply as mobile regions fragment into percolating fractal clusters, consistent with a reduction of configurational entropy predicted for fragile glass formers. This approach enables temperature-dependent scaling of viscosity and extraction of characteristic temperatures marking the ergodic-to-nonergodic crossover, within a solid-state device architecture where conventional rheological characterization is inapplicable. Further, polymer confinement of the ionic liquid shifts these characteristic temperatures upward, demonstrating the sensitivity of this method to structural constraints imposed by the polymer matrix.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：demonstrate、field-effect transistor、electrical probe、temperature evolution、time-resolved current transients。；研究对象：过冷离子液体（fragile ionic glass formers）在接近玻璃化转变时的弛豫动力学，以及利用双极性PdSe₂场效应晶体管在固态器件环境中对其进行电学探测。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过双极性PdSe₂场效应晶体管的电学测量，能够分辨过冷离子液体中离子特定的弛豫动力学，并半定量推断其流变学参数；电学可测量量p_eq(T)可追踪动态平衡液体区域的连续减少，并揭示其向渗流分形簇的碎裂过程，与脆性玻璃形成体的构型熵降低一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过双极性PdSe₂场效应晶体管的电学测量，能够分辨过冷离子液体中离子特定的弛豫动力学，并半定量推断其流变学参数；电学可测量量p_eq(T)可追踪动态平衡液体区域的连续减少，并揭示其向渗流分形簇的碎裂过程，与脆性玻璃形成体的构型熵降低一致。；创新点：首次在固态器件架构中利用双极性晶体管实现对过冷离子液体离子弛豫动力学的电学访问，并半定量推断流变学参数，克服了传统流变测量在集成电子结构中不兼容的问题；同时展示了该方法对聚合物基质施加的结构约束的敏感性（如特征温度上移）。
papers.method_zh: 采用双极性PdSe₂场效应晶体管作为电学探针，测量转移曲线滞后的温度演化以及离子栅脉冲下的时间分辨电流瞬态；通过电学量p_eq(T)量化在实验时间尺度内能够弛豫的移动离子分数，并据此提取特征温度（如遍历-非遍历交叉温度）和粘度随温度变化的标度关系。

papers.title: Effect of inter-edge interaction in a quantum Hall collider
papers.abstract: Fractional quantum Hall (FQH) colliders measure anyon exchange phases via time-domain braiding, but the $ν=2/5$ state exhibits an intriguing negative Fano factor, challenging theoretical predictions. Here, we study the effect of inter-edge interactions in a multi-mode FQH collider. We demonstrate that the resulting fractionalization into eigenmodes causes the anyon beam to decompose into correlated and uncorrelated components, which have very distinct behavior in terms of time-domain braiding. We show that the uncorrelated part dominates in the long-junction limit, reversing the tunneling current sign and reproducing the observed negative Fano factor at $ν=2/5$. Our results highlight the role of interactions and provide a robust interpretation of anyonic braiding in multi-mode systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：study, demonstrate, show（理论分析与模型推导）。；研究对象：多模分数量子霍尔（FQH）边缘态中的量子霍尔对撞机，特别是ν=2/5态中边缘间相互作用对任意子束时间域编织的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 边缘间相互作用导致任意子束分解为关联与不关联两部分，其中不关联部分在长结极限下主导输运，反转隧穿电流符号，从而解释了ν=2/5态中观测到的负Fano因子。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：边缘间相互作用导致任意子束分解为关联与不关联两部分，其中不关联部分在长结极限下主导输运，反转隧穿电流符号，从而解释了ν=2/5态中观测到的负Fano因子。；创新点：揭示了边缘间相互作用在多模系统中对任意子编织信号的关键影响，为ν=2/5态中反常负Fano因子提供了理论解释。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：通过研究多模FQH对撞机中边缘间相互作用导致的分数化（fractionalization）为特征模，分析任意子束在时间域编织中的行为，并推导长结极限下的隧穿电流符号与Fano因子。

papers.title: AC calorimetric study of magneto-quantum oscillations in anisotropic multiband V$_2$Ga$_5$ superconductor
papers.abstract: Unlike de Haas--van Alphen measurements, heat-capacity magneto-quantum oscillations directly probe the oscillatory bulk quasiparticle density of states. Here, we report the observation of MQOs in V$_2$Ga$_5$ single crystals studied via highly sensitive ac calorimetry. The strongest MQO signal is observed for a magnetic field applied along the vanadium chains, in excellent agreement with de Haas--van Alphen magnetization data. A single dominant frequency of 126.6 T resolved by fast Fourier transform confirms the true bulk origin of the elliptical $γ$ Fermi-surface pocket located near the Z point of the Brillouin zone. The angular dependence of the FFT frequency closely tracks the anisotropy of the $γ$ pocket, as supported by first-principles calculations. Analysis of the temperature- and field-dependent MQO amplitudes allows the precise determination of the effective cyclotron mass, Dingle temperature, quantum relaxation time, carrier mobility, and electron mean free path. Furthermore, we demonstrate that the net Berry flux is invariant with respect to the magnetic-field orientation, as a consequence of a conserved hybridization phase twist within the $γ$ pocket. These findings establish ac calorimetry as a powerful macroscopic probe of topological orbital hybridization in complex intermetallics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“highly sensitive ac calorimetry”、“observation of MQOs”、“analysis of temperature- and field-dependent MQO amplitudes”等实验测量与数据分析关键词。；研究对象：各向异性多带超导体V₂Ga₅单晶，具体研究其磁量子振荡（MQO）现象及费米面拓扑性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在V₂Ga₅单晶中观测到热容磁量子振荡，确认了位于布里渊区Z点附近的椭圆γ费米面口袋的体态起源，并发现净贝里通量不随磁场方向变化，表明γ口袋内存在守恒的杂化相位扭曲。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在V₂Ga₅单晶中观测到热容磁量子振荡，确认了位于布里渊区Z点附近的椭圆γ费米面口袋的体态起源，并发现净贝里通量不随磁场方向变化，表明γ口袋内存在守恒的杂化相位扭曲。；创新点：首次利用交流量热法在V₂Ga₅中观测到热容磁量子振荡，并证明该方法可作为探测复杂金属间化合物中拓扑轨道杂化的宏观探针；同时揭示了γ费米面口袋中贝里通量对磁场方向的不变性。
papers.method_zh: 高灵敏度交流量热法（ac calorimetry）测量热容磁量子振荡，结合快速傅里叶变换（FFT）分析振荡频率，通过温度与磁场依赖的振荡振幅提取有效回旋质量、丁格尔温度、量子弛豫时间、载流子迁移率及电子平均自由程，并辅以第一性原理计算支持角度依赖分析。

papers.title: AC-flux-driven SQUID diode spectroscopy as a probe of current-phase relations
papers.abstract: The current-phase relation (CPR) of a Josephson junction encodes microscopic information on superconducting states through higher-order and fractional harmonics. However, their unambiguous extraction is challenging, as different CPR components produce nearly identical static interference patterns that are further obscured by device asymmetries, damping, and dynamical effects. Here, we propose probing individual CPR harmonics via the ac magnetic-flux-driven diode effect in asymmetric dc SQUIDs with unequal junction critical currents. Using two complementary reductions of the fast-driven dynamics -- a Kapitza-type perturbation theory for the conventional junction and a Jacobi--Anger averaging for a general CPR -- we show that ac flux modulation dresses each harmonic with a distinct Bessel function, yielding characteristic signatures in the diode efficiency $η(φ_{\rm ac},ω)$ as a function of ac flux amplitude $φ_{\rm ac}$ and frequency $ω$. We verify and extend these predictions by numerical solutions of the coupled dynamical equations for CPRs containing $\sin\varphi$, $\sin(\varphi/2)$, and $\sin 2\varphi$ terms ($\varphi$: superconducting phase difference), and construct phase diagrams of $η(φ_{\rm ac},ω)$. Distinct CPR components are revealed to produce characteristic weak, sparse, dense, or intermodulated arc patterns that remain robust in both overdamped and underdamped regimes. This suggests ac-flux-driven SQUID diode spectroscopy as a probe of current-phase relations in topological materials, multiband systems, and other unconventional superconductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：propose、perturbation theory、averaging、numerical solutions、construct phase diagrams）；研究对象：非对称直流SQUID（dc SQUID）中由交流磁通驱动的二极管效应，以及约瑟夫森结的电流-相位关系（CPR）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 交流磁通调制会使CPR的每个谐波被不同的贝塞尔函数“修饰”，从而在二极管效率η(φ_ac, ω)随交流磁通振幅φ_ac和频率ω变化的特性中产生特征性信号；不同CPR分量（如sinφ、sin(φ/2)、sin2φ）会产生特征性的弱、稀疏、密集或互调弧状图案，且这些图案在过阻尼和欠阻尼状态下均保持稳健。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：交流磁通调制会使CPR的每个谐波被不同的贝塞尔函数“修饰”，从而在二极管效率η(φ_ac, ω)随交流磁通振幅φ_ac和频率ω变化的特性中产生特征性信号；不同CPR分量（如sinφ、sin(φ/2)、sin2φ）会产生特征性的弱、稀疏、密集或互调弧状图案，且这些图案在过阻尼和欠阻尼状态下均保持稳健。；创新点：提出利用交流磁通驱动的SQUID二极管效应作为探测CPR各谐波分量的光谱学手段，能够区分不同谐波成分产生的特征性二极管效率图案，从而克服传统静态干涉测量中不同CPR分量难以区分的困难。
papers.method_zh: 采用两种互补的快速驱动动力学约化方法：针对常规结的Kapitza型微扰理论，以及针对一般CPR的Jacobi-Anger平均方法；并通过数值求解包含sinφ、sin(φ/2)和sin2φ项的耦合动力学方程进行验证和扩展。

papers.title: Using fast-reactive crosslinkers to modulate the internal structure of thermoresponsive microgels
papers.abstract: The internal architecture of poly(N-isopropylacrylamide) (PNIPAM) microgels, which switches from fuzzy-sphere to star-like when the standard N,N'-methylenebis(acrylamide) (BIS) crosslinker is replaced with ethylene glycol dimethacrylate (EGDMA), critically determines their interactions and swelling behavior. Here, we systematically investigate the role of the surfactant and crosslinker content in modulating the internal structure of the microgels using Dynamic Light Scattering, Small-angle X-ray Scattering and monomer-resolved numerical simulations. We reveal that the presence of the surfactant is crucial for obtaining the star-like architecture, and that the transition from the star-like regime to a more core-dominated structure occurs above a threshold EGDMA concentration. Monomer-resolved simulations capture how the role of surfactant differs between EGDMA-crosslinked and BIS-crosslinked microgels. Our findings establish a direct synthesis-structure relationship, providing a clear guidance for the rational design of soft, star-like microgels with ultra-soft interactions, strenghtening the connection between microgels and model star polymers.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与计算结合）。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了“Dynamic Light Scattering, Small-angle X-ray Scattering”等实验手段，以及“monomer-resolved numerical simulations”计算方法。；研究对象：热响应性微凝胶，具体为聚(N-异丙基丙烯酰胺)（PNIPAM）微凝胶，其内部结构可通过使用快速反应交联剂（如乙二醇二甲基丙烯酸酯，EGDMA）进行调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 揭示了表面活性剂和交联剂含量是调控微凝胶从“模糊球”结构转变为“星形”结构的关键因素；当EGDMA浓度超过某一阈值时，结构会从星形转变为更核心主导的结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：揭示了表面活性剂和交联剂含量是调控微凝胶从“模糊球”结构转变为“星形”结构的关键因素；当EGDMA浓度超过某一阈值时，结构会从星形转变为更核心主导的结构。；创新点：建立了从合成条件（表面活性剂和交联剂含量）到微凝胶内部结构（星形 vs. 核心主导）的直接关联，为理性设计具有超软相互作用的星形微凝胶提供了清晰指导，加强了微凝胶与模型星形聚合物之间的联系。
papers.method_zh: 动态光散射（DLS）、小角X射线散射（SAXS）实验，以及单体分辨数值模拟。

papers.title: First-order phase transitions in the three-dimensional Blume-Capel ferromagnet
papers.abstract: We investigate first-order phase transitions in the three-dimensional Blume-Capel ferromagnet on the simple cubic lattice by combining multicanonical simulations with two-parameter Wang-Landau sampling. The generalized-ensemble approach enables a detailed characterization of the coexistence region over a broad range of temperatures and crystal-field couplings, extending from the vicinity of the tricritical point deep into the first-order regime. We analyze the finite-size scaling behavior of thermodynamic observables, with particular emphasis on the energy probability density function, free-energy barriers, and interfacial properties. The evolution of the double-peaked energy distributions reveals a gradual crossover from weak to strong first-order behavior as the temperature is lowered. From the scaling of the free-energy barrier we determine the interface tension along the coexistence line and characterize its approach to the tricritical region through its vanishing behavior. In parallel, a field-mixing analysis based on the joint density of states obtained from two-parameter Wang-Landau simulations is employed to locate first-order transition points and probe tricritical behavior. While this approach has been highly successful in two-dimensional realizations of the Blume-Capel model, we find that in three dimensions its practical implementation becomes increasingly sensitive in the vicinity of the tricritical region, where the shallow structure of the relevant scaling variable distribution limits the ability to resolve coexistence conditions for the system sizes currently accessible. These results delineate the range of applicability of the method in three dimensions and provide a consistent picture of the first-order regime of the model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：multicanonical simulations、two-parameter Wang-Landau sampling、finite-size scaling、field-mixing analysis。；研究对象：三维简单立方晶格上的Blume-Capel铁磁体中的一级相变行为，特别是从三临界点附近到深一级相变区域的共存区特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过广义系综模拟，揭示了随温度降低，能量概率密度函数从弱一级相变到强一级相变的连续演化；并利用自由能势垒的标度行为确定了共存线上的界面张力及其在三临界点附近的消失行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过广义系综模拟，揭示了随温度降低，能量概率密度函数从弱一级相变到强一级相变的连续演化；并利用自由能势垒的标度行为确定了共存线上的界面张力及其在三临界点附近的消失行为。；创新点：系统刻画了三维Blume-Capel模型从三临界点深入一级相变区域的完整相变特征，并检验了在二维模型中非常成功的场混合分析方法在三维中的适用性——发现该方法在三临界点附近因相关标度变量分布结构平坦而难以分辨共存条件，从而明确了该方法的适用范围。
papers.method_zh: 结合多正则模拟与双参数Wang-Landau采样的广义系综方法；有限尺寸标度分析（重点分析能量概率密度函数、自由能势垒和界面性质）；基于联合态密度的场混合分析用于定位一级相变点和探测三临界行为。

papers.title: Surface Induced Magnetism of CdSe Quantum Dots: A DFT Study
papers.abstract: Surface induced magnetism of quantum dots is not well understood and has been a subject of considerable controversy because of the complexity of surface chemistry of quantum dot facets coupled with the many degrees of freedom inherently involved in magnetism. We performed spin-polarized colinear density functional theory calculations to study charge and spin densities to determine surface reconstructions in bare as well as passivated quantum dots in controlled way. We find that tricoordinated surface atoms relax contributing no dangling bonds and bi-coordinated atoms dimerize, reducing the population of the dangling bonds affecting the induced magnetism. As a result, bicoordinated rather than tricoordinated surface atoms are responsible for spin polarized surface states. In light of recent advanced experimental tools, we predict dangling bonds that remain, despite passivation, on low index facets with bicoordinated atoms could result in tunable surface magnetism. Our results also shed light on the contradicting experimental results in the literature.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：spin-polarized colinear density functional theory calculations（自旋极化共线密度泛函理论计算）、DFT。；研究对象：CdSe量子点的表面诱导磁性。具体涉及裸表面和钝化表面的表面重构、悬挂键与自旋极化态的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 双配位表面原子（而非三配位原子）是产生自旋极化表面态的主要原因；钝化后仍残留在低指数晶面上的悬挂键可能导致可调谐的表面磁性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：双配位表面原子（而非三配位原子）是产生自旋极化表面态的主要原因；钝化后仍残留在低指数晶面上的悬挂键可能导致可调谐的表面磁性。；创新点：通过区分三配位与双配位表面原子的不同作用，明确了双配位原子是自旋极化的关键来源，并预测钝化后残留悬挂键可调控表面磁性，为解释文献中矛盾的实验结果提供了新视角。
papers.method_zh: 采用自旋极化共线密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，系统研究裸表面和钝化量子点的电荷密度与自旋密度，分析表面重构对悬挂键和诱导磁性的影响。

papers.title: Graphene Josephson diodes from inherent asymmetric disorder
papers.abstract: Josephson diodes are non-reciprocal superconducting devices characterized by different switching currents depending on the current flow direction. They recently attracted considerable theoretical and experimental attention, in view of their possible application as rectifying elements in the field of superconducting electronics, and as probes to investigate symmetry breaking mechanisms in mesoscopic systems. In this work, we show that graphene Josephson junctions provide rectification of supercurrent with an efficiency exceeding 20%. The effect appears applying a mT out-of-plane magnetic field and is enhanced close to the nodes of the Fraunhofer interference pattern. Our theoretical model identifies long-range scattering potentials in the junction as the symmetry-breaking mechanism, which yields supercurrent rectification in highly transparent junctions. While graphene stands as an ultra-clean transmission medium, our work shows that unavoidable residual disorder in a clean two-dimensional system is sufficient to promote this effect. Tailoring of the inversion (mirror) symmetry breaking could be obtained via proper design of external gates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验与理论结合的文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“实验上展示”（provide rectification）和“理论模型识别”（our theoretical model identifies）。；研究对象：石墨烯约瑟夫森结中的超流整流现象，即约瑟夫森二极管效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在毫特斯拉量级的垂直磁场下，石墨烯约瑟夫森结可实现超过20%的超流整流效率，该效应在夫琅禾费干涉图样的节点附近显著增强。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在毫特斯拉量级的垂直磁场下，石墨烯约瑟夫森结可实现超过20%的超流整流效率，该效应在夫琅禾费干涉图样的节点附近显著增强。；创新点：揭示了在洁净二维体系（石墨烯）中，不可避免的残余无序（长程散射势）足以打破反演对称性，从而产生约瑟夫森二极管效应，而非依赖人为设计的对称性破缺结构。
papers.method_zh: 实验上测量石墨烯约瑟夫森结在不同方向电流下的开关电流；理论上建立包含长程散射势的模型，解释对称性破缺机制。

papers.title: Probing La-based nickelates with Ni 1$s$ core-level photoelectron spectroscopy
papers.abstract: We present a comparative Ni core level photoemission study of La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$, Nd$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$, and LaNiO$_3$ using both the Ni $2p$ and the Ni $1s$. We address the challenges in analyzing the widely investigated Ni $2p$ spectra arising from the substantial overlap in energy of the Ni $2p$ with the La $3d$. We show that on the other hand the deep Ni $1s$ core level does provide a clean view on the intrinsic electronic excitations and we highlight its potential to resolve detailed differences in the electronic structure within the strongly correlated Ruddlesden-Popper series La$_{n+1}$Ni$_n$O$_{3n+1}$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“core level photoemission study”（核心能级光电子能谱研究）、“Ni 2p and Ni 1s”（Ni 2p和1s能级）、“spectra”（光谱）。；研究对象：La₃Ni₂O₇、Nd₃Ni₂O₇和LaNiO₃这三种镍基氧化物，属于强关联Ruddlesden-Popper系列Laₙ₊₁NiₙO₃ₙ₊₁。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Ni 1s核心能级光电子能谱能够清晰揭示本征电子激发，避免了Ni 2p谱与La 3d能级在能量上严重重叠带来的分析困难，并可用于分辨该系列材料中电子结构的细微差异。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Ni 1s核心能级光电子能谱能够清晰揭示本征电子激发，避免了Ni 2p谱与La 3d能级在能量上严重重叠带来的分析困难，并可用于分辨该系列材料中电子结构的细微差异。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用Ni 2p和Ni 1s核心能级光电子能谱（X射线光电子能谱，XPS）进行对比实验测量。

papers.title: Ground-state properties of the $S=3/2$ anisotropic triangular lattice antiferromagnet Na$_3$Cr(PO$_4$)$_2$
papers.abstract: We report the crystal structure and magnetic properties of a $S=3/2$ anisotropic triangular lattice compound Na$_3$Cr(PO$_4$)$_2$ employing single-crystal and powder x-ray diffraction, magnetization, heat capacity, and $^{31}$P nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) experiments, supported by the band structure calculations. Magnetic susceptibility exhibits a broad maximum around 3.5 K, indicating the presence of a short-range antiferromagnetic order, typical of a low-dimensional spin system. Magnetization and heat capacity manifest an antiferromagnetic long-range ordering at around $T_{\rm N} \simeq 2.6$ K. This was further confirmed by the drastic NMR line broadening and a peak in the nuclear spin-lattice and spin-spin relaxation rates. The isothermal magnetization data exhibit a field-induced spin-flop transition at around $μ_0H_{\rm SF} \simeq 1.7$ T reminiscent of an anisotropic two-dimensional magnet, before saturating above $μ_0H_{\rm sat} \simeq 4.5$ T. The saturation field was further upheld by the field-dependent NMR relaxation measurements at low temperatures. The $^{31}$P NMR spectral shape confirms the commensurate antiferromagnetic nature of the ordering below $T_{\rm N}$. \textit{Ab initio} calculations reveal a significant deformation of the triangular spin lattice, resulting in triangles with two antiferromagnetic couplings of similar strength and a much weaker coupling along the third side of the triangle.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（辅以计算）。判断依据：摘要明确提及单晶与粉末X射线衍射、磁化率、比热、核磁共振（NMR）等实验手段，并辅以能带结构计算（ab initio calculations）。；研究对象：S=3/2各向异性三角晶格反铁磁体Na₃Cr(PO₄)₂。具体研究其晶体结构、磁基态性质及磁场响应行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该化合物在约2.6 K发生反铁磁长程有序，并在约1.7 T处出现自旋翻转转变，表明其为各向异性二维磁体；第一性原理计算揭示三角自旋晶格存在显著畸变，形成两个强度相近的反铁磁耦合边与一个弱耦合边。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该化合物在约2.6 K发生反铁磁长程有序，并在约1.7 T处出现自旋翻转转变，表明其为各向异性二维磁体；第一性原理计算揭示三角自旋晶格存在显著畸变，形成两个强度相近的反铁磁耦合边与一个弱耦合边。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 单晶与粉末X射线衍射、磁化率与等温磁化测量、比热测量、³¹P核磁共振（包括谱线、自旋-晶格弛豫率与自旋-自旋弛豫率），以及基于第一性原理的能带结构计算。

papers.title: Work Extraction via Backward Motion in Optimal Closed-Loop Stochastic Control
papers.abstract: We experimentally realize finite-time feedback control in an overdamped colloidal system using real-time optical tweezers with in situ reinforcement learning (RL). By varying the protocol duration tf for displacing the optical trap between prescribed positions, the optimal strategies identified by RL reveal a crossover from deterministic dragging toward the target to feedback-assisted exploitation of thermal fluctuations, reducing and eventually overcoming the energetic cost. The resulting policies agree quantitatively with the exact optimal closed-loop solution. By extending the approach to spatially localized external forcing, we further show that RL can identify optimal feedback strategies in heterogeneous stochastic environments where direct analytical control design is challenging.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：experimentally realize、real-time optical tweezers、in situ reinforcement learning）；研究对象：过阻尼胶体系统中的有限时间反馈控制，具体为通过光镊移动光学陷阱的随机热力学过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 强化学习识别的最优控制策略揭示了从确定性拖拽到利用热涨落的反馈辅助的交叉行为，能够降低并最终克服能量成本；该方法还可推广到异质随机环境中的最优反馈控制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：强化学习识别的最优控制策略揭示了从确定性拖拽到利用热涨落的反馈辅助的交叉行为，能够降低并最终克服能量成本；该方法还可推广到异质随机环境中的最优反馈控制。；创新点：首次在实验上利用强化学习实现了过阻尼胶体系统中有限时间反馈控制的最优策略识别，并展示了在异质随机环境中（直接解析控制设计困难）RL仍能发现最优反馈策略。
papers.method_zh: 实时光镊实验结合原位强化学习（RL），通过改变协议持续时间tf，在预设位置间移动光学陷阱，并对比精确最优闭环解进行定量验证。

papers.title: Atomic-scale sensing of photoexcitation processes in electronically isolated molecules via atomic force microscopy
papers.abstract: Atomic-scale insights into light-matter interaction can be obtained using light-assisted scanning probe microscopy techniques. Recently, photoexcited charge carriers have been detected by means of scanning tunnelling microscopy, enabling the study of photo-induced charge transfer with atomic-scale spatial resolution. Here, we propose an approach based on atomic force microscopy (AFM), namely photoexcitation single-charge AFM (PE-AFM), to detect photoexcitation in single molecules adsorbed on non-conductive dielectric films. Synchronizing laser pulses to the oscillation of the tip of an AFM enables the detection of electron tunnelling events that follow photoexcitation. We demonstrate the PE-AFM technique for individual copper phthalocyanine molecules and achieve photoexcitation-driven AFM contrast with ångström spatial resolution. The observed sub-molecular contrast suggests the involvement of a long-lived quadruplet excited state. When combined with the recently developed AFM excited-state spectroscopy including lifetime measurements, PE-AFM enables comprehensive characterization of electronic states involved in photoexcitation and subsequent intersystem crossing, establishing a powerful platform for investigating photophysical processes at the single-molecule level.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了实验技术（photoexcitation single-charge AFM, PE-AFM）及其在单个分子上的演示，并提及了实验对比和空间分辨率等实验特征。；研究对象：单个铜酞菁（copper phthalocyanine）分子吸附在非导电介电薄膜上的光激发过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将激光脉冲与原子力显微镜（AFM）探针振荡同步，实现了对单个分子光激发后电子隧穿事件的探测，并获得了具有埃级空间分辨率的光激发驱动AFM对比度，暗示了长寿命四重激发态的存在。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将激光脉冲与原子力显微镜（AFM）探针振荡同步，实现了对单个分子光激发后电子隧穿事件的探测，并获得了具有埃级空间分辨率的光激发驱动AFM对比度，暗示了长寿命四重激发态的存在。；创新点：提出并演示了一种基于原子力显微镜（而非扫描隧道显微镜）来探测非导电基底上单个分子光激发过程的方法（PE-AFM），实现了在绝缘体系中对光激发过程的原子尺度传感。
papers.method_zh: 光激发单电荷原子力显微镜（PE-AFM）。具体手段包括：将激光脉冲与AFM探针的振荡同步，以检测光激发后的电子隧穿事件；结合了AFM激发态光谱学及寿命测量技术。

papers.title: Defect Localization by Stress Anisotropy in Active Nematic Turbulence
papers.abstract: Collective stress generation in cellular monolayers is a key phenomenological process governing coordinated migration and emergent multicellular dynamics. We employ a generic active nematics model to investigate stress generation and its associated properties. By analyzing the maximal principal stress and its correlation with the nematic director across different activity strengths, we find that the principal stress aligns perpendicular (parallel) to the nematic director for extensile (contractile) activity. In the turbulent regime, we identify a distinct isoline derived from anisotropic stress components along which all $\pm 1/2$ defects (both nematic and stress) are localized. This feature is robust and remains unchanged with variations in both the magnitude and nature (extensile or contractile) of activity. Our findings provide a new route to probe the mechanical and rheological properties of confluent cell layers, where stress measurements are more accessible than detailed cell shape or size characterization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：active nematics model（活性向列模型）、analyzing（分析）、generic model（通用模型）。；研究对象：活性向列湍流中由应力各向异性导致的缺陷局域化现象，具体涉及细胞单层中的集体应力产生及其与向列缺陷的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在活性向列湍流中，所有±1/2缺陷（包括向列缺陷和应力缺陷）均局域在由各向异性应力分量导出的特定等值线上，且该特征对活性强度及活性类型（伸展型或收缩型）均保持鲁棒。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在活性向列湍流中，所有±1/2缺陷（包括向列缺陷和应力缺陷）均局域在由各向异性应力分量导出的特定等值线上，且该特征对活性强度及活性类型（伸展型或收缩型）均保持鲁棒。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用通用活性向列模型（generic active nematics model）进行数值模拟，通过分析最大主应力及其与向列指向矢在不同活性强度下的相关性，并提取各向异性应力分量的等值线来定位缺陷。

papers.title: Brownian gyration of an inertial ellipsoid
papers.abstract: Recent studies on Brownian gyration (BG) have focused primarily on spherically symmetric particles under overdamped conditions. To explore BG in the underdamped regime with a spherically asymmetric particle, we investigate the inertial dynamics of a microscopic ellipsoid in a dissipative medium. The particle is confined in a spherically asymmetric trap and simultaneously coupled to two distinct thermal reservoirs. This configuration drives the system into a nonequilibrium steady state (NESS) characterised by BG, which is quantified by the mean and fluctuation of the particle's specific angular momentum. Using inertial Langevin dynamics, we systematically analyze how this microscopic gyration depends not merely on the trap asymmetry and temperature difference, but also on the particle's intrinsic physical properties like shape and axial orientation, besides inertia. Our study uncovers fundamental differences between the gyration of spherical and non-spherical particles in overdamped as well as underdamped conditions, at microscopic scales. These findings provide key insights for optimizing Brownian gyration across a broader landscape of experimentally tuneable parameters.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了“inertial Langevin dynamics”（惯性朗之万动力学）进行“systematically analyze”（系统分析），属于理论建模与计算研究。；研究对象：一个在耗散介质中运动的微观椭球体。该椭球体被囚禁在一个非球对称的势阱中，并同时耦合到两个不同温度的热库，从而产生布朗回转现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非球形粒子的布朗回转不仅依赖于势阱不对称性和温差，还显著依赖于粒子自身的物理属性（如形状、轴向取向）以及惯性。这揭示了在微观尺度下，球形与非球形粒子在过阻尼和欠阻尼条件下的回转行为存在根本性差异。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非球形粒子的布朗回转不仅依赖于势阱不对称性和温差，还显著依赖于粒子自身的物理属性（如形状、轴向取向）以及惯性。这揭示了在微观尺度下，球形与非球形粒子在过阻尼和欠阻尼条件下的回转行为存在根本性差异。；创新点：将布朗回转的研究从过阻尼条件下的球形对称粒子，拓展到了欠阻尼条件下的非球形（椭球）粒子，并系统分析了粒子形状、轴向取向和惯性等内在属性对回转行为的影响。
papers.method_zh: 采用惯性朗之万动力学（inertial Langevin dynamics）进行理论建模与分析。通过计算粒子特定角动量的平均值和涨落来量化布朗回转。

papers.title: Beyond the interface: Persistent Hopping Transport and Frequency Dispersion in Strong-inversion Cryogenic MOSFETs
papers.abstract: Cryogenic complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor (cryo-CMOS) technology is essential for quantum computing interfaces, which require precise modeling of dynamic device behavior. The output impedance of MOS field-effect transistors (MOSFETs) is frequency dependent, which has been conventionally attributed to extrinsic parasitics. Here, we report an intrinsic frequency dispersion in the channel impedance of cryogenic MOSFETs that persists deep into the strong-inversion region. Through a Cole-Cole analysis, we characterize this dispersion as a depressed semicircle in the impedance plane and attribute its behavior to variable-range hopping through band-tail localized states. Unlike conventional models where band-tail states are confined to the oxide interface, we demonstrate that in MOSFETs with high channel doping the band-tail states are induced by ionized impurities and distributed throughout the depletion region. Our paradigm accounts for frequency dispersion under strong inversion. This work demonstrates that ionized-impurities-induced hopping governs the dynamic response of cryo-MOSFETs channel impedance even when drift conduction dominates, offering critical insights for accurate small-signal modeling and high-frequency cryo-CMOS circuit design.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：Cole-Cole分析、阻抗测量、频率色散表征）；研究对象：强反型低温MOSFET（金属-氧化物-半导体场效应晶体管）的沟道阻抗频率色散现象，特别是由电离杂质诱导的带尾态跳跃输运。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在强反型区，低温MOSFET的沟道阻抗存在本征频率色散，该色散源于通过电离杂质诱导的带尾局域态的可变程跳跃，而非传统认为的界面态或外部寄生效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在强反型区，低温MOSFET的沟道阻抗存在本征频率色散，该色散源于通过电离杂质诱导的带尾局域态的可变程跳跃，而非传统认为的界面态或外部寄生效应。；创新点：突破了传统模型中带尾态仅局限于氧化物界面的假设，证明在高掺杂沟道中，电离杂质会在整个耗尽区诱导分布式的带尾态，从而解释了强反型下仍存在的频率色散现象。
papers.method_zh: 通过阻抗谱测量（Cole-Cole分析）表征频率色散，结合强反型条件下高沟道掺杂MOSFET的物理模型，分析带尾态分布与跳跃输运机制。

papers.title: Anomalous Pairing Currents and a Second Topological Edge Channel in Bosonic Lattices
papers.abstract: We show that bosonic pairing opens a second chiral current channel on a 2D kagome lattice, absent from any particle-conserving model. From the continuity equation, we derive both a hopping current and an anomalous pairing current on the lattice, and predict chiral circulation in bulk-gapped phases with integer para-unitary Chern numbers, as well as a phase-sensitive leakage ratio, $Λ_{\cal I}$, for the pairing current around a defect. This ratio can be tuned from confined to strongly anomalous regimes at fixed topology. The two channels differ microscopically: the hopping current is sourced by the on-bond single-particle coherence, whereas the pairing current is sourced by the off-site anomalous coherence, whose spatial range is governed by the BdG pairing gap rather than by the single-particle gap. This separation produces distinct defect-induced signatures in real space, identifies a regime in which bulk topology and anomalous edge response coexist with no analogue in particle-conserving matter, and is directly testable in driven photonic lattices and superconducting-circuit arrays.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“We show”、“We derive”、“predict”等理论推导和预言性词汇，未提及任何实验数据或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：玻色子晶格中的反常配对流与拓扑边缘态。具体体系为二维kagome晶格上的玻色子系统，以及可类比的光子晶格和超导电路阵列。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在二维kagome玻色子晶格中，玻色子配对会打开一个粒子数守恒模型中不存在的第二手性边缘通道。该通道由反常配对流驱动，其空间范围由BdG配对能隙而非单粒子能隙决定，并可在固定拓扑下从受限区连续调谐至强反常区。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在二维kagome玻色子晶格中，玻色子配对会打开一个粒子数守恒模型中不存在的第二手性边缘通道。该通道由反常配对流驱动，其空间范围由BdG配对能隙而非单粒子能隙决定，并可在固定拓扑下从受限区连续调谐至强反常区。；创新点：首次在玻色子晶格中预言了由配对流产生的第二手性边缘通道，该通道在粒子数守恒系统中不存在。揭示了跳跃流与配对流在微观起源（单粒子相干 vs. 离位反常相干）和空间尺度（单粒子能隙 vs. BdG配对能隙）上的本质区别，并指出体拓扑与反常边缘响应共存的新奇相，这在粒子数守恒物质中无对应物。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于连续性方程推导了晶格上的跳跃流和反常配对流；利用para-幺正陈数（para-unitary Chern numbers）表征体相拓扑；通过缺陷周围的配对流相位敏感泄漏比Λ_I分析边缘响应。

papers.title: Flat-Band Stoner Instability and Peierls-Phase Origin of the Transdimensional Anomalous Hall Effect in Rhombohedral Graphite
papers.abstract: A ``transdimensional'' anomalous Hall effect (TDAHE), where both in-plane ($\Bpar$) and out-of-plane magnetic fields produce hysteretic Hall signals, was recently observed in nine-layer rhombohedral graphite~\cite{Li2026Nature}. We present a microscopic theory attributing the TDAHE to a flat-band Stoner instability coupled to Peierls-phase gap modulation. The flat-band density of states satisfies the Stoner criterion $Uρ(\varepsilon_F) > 1$~\cite{Bultinck2020}, driving a spin-valley-locked ferromagnet whose valley polarization $η$ breaks time-reversal symmetry and generates an intrinsic anomalous Hall conductivity (AHC). The orbital $g$-factor $g_{\mathrm{orb}} = e d_0 v_F (N{-}1)/2 \propto (N{-}1)$ then lets $\Bpar$ modulate the gap, producing the transdimensional response $\propto η$. A self-consistent $2N$-band Hartree-Fock calculation yields complete valley polarization ($η\to 1$) below a mean-field transition $T_c^{\mathrm{MF}} \approx 2.2$~K, reduced by 2D-Ising critical fluctuations to the experimental $T_c \approx 1.6$~K, with $R_{xy} \approx 1.5$~k$Ω$. Because both Hall responses are carried by one order parameter $η$, they share a single $T_c$, as observed; $T_c$ is governed by the Stoner product $Uρ$ and is insensitive to the intervalley exchange, which only gates whether the valley-polarized phase forms, so the exchange strength is not a fitted parameter. Beyond reproducing $R_{xy}$, $T_c$, and the phase window, the theory predicts a sharp onset of valley polarization between $N = 7$ and $N = 9$, a symmetry selection rule fixing the crescent Fermi surface to the $m{=}1$ nematic channel, and a transdimensional-to-conventional Hall ratio $\sigmaPHE/\sigmaAHE^{\mathrm{tot}} = g_{\mathrm{orb}}\Bpar/m$ independent of $η$ and $U$. The $Z$-independence of the intrinsic AHC is verified within dynamical mean-field theory.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：microscopic theory、self-consistent Hartree-Fock calculation、dynamical mean-field theory）；研究对象：九层菱方石墨（rhombohedral graphite）中观测到的“跨维度反常霍尔效应”（transdimensional anomalous Hall effect, TDAHE）
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该理论将TDAHE归因于平带Stoner不稳定性与Peierls相位间隙调制的耦合：平带态密度满足Stoner判据，驱动自旋-谷锁定的铁磁序，其谷极化η同时产生内禀反常霍尔电导，并通过轨道g因子使面内磁场调制能隙，从而产生跨维度霍尔响应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该理论将TDAHE归因于平带Stoner不稳定性与Peierls相位间隙调制的耦合：平带态密度满足Stoner判据，驱动自旋-谷锁定的铁磁序，其谷极化η同时产生内禀反常霍尔电导，并通过轨道g因子使面内磁场调制能隙，从而产生跨维度霍尔响应。；创新点：首次从微观机制上解释了菱方石墨中面内与面外磁场均产生磁滞霍尔信号的跨维度反常霍尔效应，并指出该效应由单一序参量η承载，因此两个霍尔响应共享同一转变温度T_c；理论还预言了谷极化在N=7至N=9层数间的突然出现、新月形费米面对m=1向列通道的对称性选择，以及跨维度与常规霍尔效应的比值与η和U无关。
papers.method_zh: 自洽2N能带Hartree-Fock计算（得到平均场转变温度T_c^MF ≈ 2.2 K，经二维Ising临界涨落修正至实验值1.6 K）；动力学平均场理论（DMFT）验证内禀AHC的Z独立性。

papers.title: Hyperuniform charge distributions and phase transitions in a generalized Aubry-André model
papers.abstract: We show the existence of distinct inhomogeneous charge distributions and a phase transition between them in aperiodic fermion systems. Using a generalized Aubry-André model as an example, we obtain various types of charge distributions, which we classify by means of hyperuniformity, a general mean to quantify and classify the global uniformity of spatial distributions. Examining various cases of filling fraction and potential strength and shape, we find that the many-body charge distribution in this model is always hyperuniform, i.e., showing an anomalously suppressed long-range fluctuation, while its hyperuniformity class depends on the localization properties of the states around the Fermi energy, irrespective of those of high-energy states. Namely, the change in the localization properties of these single-particle states leaves a signature in the hyperuniformity class of many-body charge distribution. We further show a change of the hyperuniformity class corresponds to a phase transition between inhomogeneous many-body states, and that it is of the third order.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：show, obtain, classify, find, show（均为理论推导与分类分析）。；研究对象：广义Aubry-André模型中的非周期费米子系统，具体研究其电荷分布的非均匀性及相变行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该模型中的多体电荷分布始终是超均匀的（即长程涨落被异常抑制），但超均匀性类别取决于费米能级附近单粒子态的局域化性质，且超均匀性类别的改变对应一个三阶相变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该模型中的多体电荷分布始终是超均匀的（即长程涨落被异常抑制），但超均匀性类别取决于费米能级附近单粒子态的局域化性质，且超均匀性类别的改变对应一个三阶相变。；创新点：首次将超均匀性概念应用于非周期费米子系统的多体电荷分布分类，并揭示超均匀性类别与费米能级附近单粒子态局域化性质之间的直接对应关系，进而证明超均匀性类别的改变对应一个三阶相变。
papers.method_zh: 采用广义Aubry-André模型作为理论框架，通过分析填充分数、势场强度和势场形状等参数，利用超均匀性（hyperuniformity）这一量化空间分布全局均匀性的手段对电荷分布进行分类。

papers.title: Hybrid Electronic-Ionic Ferroelectricity in Superlubric van der Waals Heterostructures
papers.abstract: One strategy to lower the switching barrier in a sliding ferroelectric (sFE) is to insert an incommensurate spacer to reduce sliding friction, creating a superlubric sliding ferroelectric (SL-sFE). However, how polarization survives across the effectively decoupled outer layers remains an open question. We show that SL-sFEs are fundamentally different from conventional sFEs: polarization is not driven by sliding alone, but by an intricate coupling between interlayer sliding and the out-of-plane buckling of the spacer layer. This coupling results in a unique hybrid electronic-ionic polarization arising from asymmetric orbital hybridization. The interplay of these order parameters generates several distinct types of ferroelectric hysteresis, including mixed first- and second-order transitions, multi-step switching, and antiferroelectric-like behavior, establishing SL-sFEs as a distinct class of ferroelectrics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“we show”“results in”“establishes”等理论推导和模型构建的表述，未提及具体实验手段或计算软件。；研究对象：超润滑滑动铁电体（superlubric sliding ferroelectric, SL-sFE），具体为在滑动铁电体中插入非公度间隔层（incommensurate spacer）形成的范德华异质结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 超润滑滑动铁电体的极化并非仅由层间滑动驱动，而是由层间滑动与间隔层面外屈曲（out-of-plane buckling）之间的复杂耦合产生，形成一种独特的混合电子-离子极化，源于不对称轨道杂化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：超润滑滑动铁电体的极化并非仅由层间滑动驱动，而是由层间滑动与间隔层面外屈曲（out-of-plane buckling）之间的复杂耦合产生，形成一种独特的混合电子-离子极化，源于不对称轨道杂化。；创新点：揭示了超润滑滑动铁电体与传统滑动铁电体的本质区别：极化机制从纯滑动驱动转变为滑动-屈曲耦合驱动的混合电子-离子极化，并预言了多种新型铁电回滞行为（如混合一级-二级相变、多步翻转、反铁电行为），将其确立为一类新的铁电体。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体理论方法，但可推断基于第一性原理或模型哈密顿量分析，涉及序参量耦合与铁电回滞类型的分类。

papers.title: Distinguishing Majorana zero modes from trivial defect states on the surface of the iron-based superconductor Fe(Te,Se)
papers.abstract: Majorana zero modes, which obey non-Abelian exchange statistics, are promising candidates for topological quantum computation due to their robustness against environmental perturbations. The iron-based superconductor Fe(Te,Se) has been identified as an intrinsic topological superconductor, possibly hosting Majorana zero modes. In this paper, we report the observation of near-zero-energy localized states at multiple structural defects on the Fe(Te,Se) surface, which could be misidentified as Majorana zero modes without additional verification. By using spin-polarized scanning tunneling spectroscopy, we demonstrate that the near-zero-energy localized states on step edges and line defects originate from topologically trivial Yu-Shiba-Rusinov states. In addition, zero-energy bound states are also observed for regions without surface defects. A combined spatial and magnetic field dependent analysis of the spin-resolved tunneling spectra in these regions reveals that this type of zero-energy states cannot be attributed to the presence of Majorana bound states. These findings emphasize the importance of spin-dependent studies of low-energy states for pursuing Majorana zero modes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提及“报告了观测结果”、“使用自旋极化扫描隧道谱”等实验手段。；研究对象：铁基超导体Fe(Te,Se)表面的马约拉纳零能模与平庸缺陷态。具体现象为：在Fe(Te,Se)表面的多种结构缺陷处观测到的近零能局域态，以及无缺陷区域观测到的零能束缚态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过自旋分辨的扫描隧道谱分析，发现Fe(Te,Se)表面台阶边缘和线缺陷处的近零能局域态源于拓扑平庸的Yu-Shiba-Rusinov态，而非马约拉纳零能模；同时，无缺陷区域的零能态也不能归因于马约拉纳束缚态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过自旋分辨的扫描隧道谱分析，发现Fe(Te,Se)表面台阶边缘和线缺陷处的近零能局域态源于拓扑平庸的Yu-Shiba-Rusinov态，而非马约拉纳零能模；同时，无缺陷区域的零能态也不能归因于马约拉纳束缚态。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但根据内容推断，其创新点在于：首次通过自旋分辨的谱学手段，系统地区分了Fe(Te,Se)表面可能被误认为马约拉纳零能模的多种平庸近零能态（包括缺陷处的Yu-Shiba-Rusinov态和无缺陷区域的零能态），强调了自旋相关研究在甄别马约拉纳零能模中的关键作用。
papers.method_zh: 主要实验手段为自旋极化扫描隧道谱（spin-polarized scanning tunneling spectroscopy）。数据分析方法包括对自旋分辨隧穿谱进行空间和磁场依赖性的联合分析。

papers.title: Vorticity Induced by Non-frontal Collisions of Quantum Droplets
papers.abstract: The rotational dynamics induced by the non-frontal binary collisions of quantum droplets composed of ultracold alkali atoms are analyzed. A theoretical study is presented within the extended Gross-Pitaevskii equation framework, using experimentally feasible conditions. Numerical experiments elucidate a rich landscape of possible topological excitations in the system that are robust towards measurements. The collision of heteronuclear quantum droplets composed of $^{41}$K and $^{87}$Rb atoms in the incompressible regime, gives rise to dynamical instabilities that spontaneously generate topological defects: vortex rings, dislocation lines, and vortices in one species. Their presence depends on the Weber number and the impact parameter. An experimental proposal for vortex detection in both real and Fourier space using interaction ramps is described.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章。关键词：theoretical study、extended Gross-Pitaevskii equation framework、numerical experiments。；研究对象：超冷碱金属原子（⁴¹K 和 ⁸⁷Rb）构成的异核量子液滴在非对心碰撞中产生的涡旋动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非对心碰撞会在不可压缩区间的异核量子液滴中自发产生多种拓扑缺陷，包括涡旋环、位错线和单组分涡旋，其出现依赖于韦伯数和碰撞参数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非对心碰撞会在不可压缩区间的异核量子液滴中自发产生多种拓扑缺陷，包括涡旋环、位错线和单组分涡旋，其出现依赖于韦伯数和碰撞参数。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于扩展Gross-Pitaevskii方程框架进行理论分析，采用实验上可行的条件进行数值模拟。

papers.title: Lifetime Sample Tracking (LiST): A Data Platform for Materials Science
papers.abstract: The 2D Crystal Consortium Materials Innovation Platform (2DCC-MIP) is an NSF supported national user facility focused on advancing the synthesis of 2D materials, monolayers, surfaces, and interfaces. The need for the facility to organize and share data with users led to the development of an internal data management and analysis engine, the Lifetime Sample Tracking platform (LiST). This infrastructure allows the automated capture, curation, analysis and dissemination of data ranging from experimental materials synthesis parameters and characterization, to theoretical first-principles and ReaxFF molecular dynamics modeling1. The system currently hosts synthesis and property data (accessible via a REST API) on approximately twenty thousand samples produced by the 2DCC grown using a variety of techniques from bulk crystal growth to metal-organic chemical vapor deposition (MOCVD) and molecular beam epitaxy (MBE), among others. Data used in publications can easily be grouped by the system into data packages that are given digital object identifiers (DOIs) for inclusion with each publication. The LiST platform is now being used by groups outside of the 2DCC as a solution for data curation in materials science. Data management tools such as LiST support the materials development process by allowing a closed loop iteration between synthesis, characterization, theory, and targeted materials design. This also enables machine learning (ML) research, artificial intelligence (AI) analysis, and the potential for autonomous synthesis in the future.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（数据平台/基础设施）。判断依据：摘要描述了为材料科学（包含实验合成与理论计算）开发的数据管理与分析引擎，属于实验与理论的交叉支撑平台。；研究对象：二维材料及其合成与表征数据的管理与分析平台。具体涉及2DCC-MIP设施中生长的约两万个样品，包括从块体晶体生长到MOCVD和MBE等多种技术制备的样品。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的物理发现。核心内容是介绍了一个名为LiST的数据平台，该平台能够实现从实验合成参数、表征数据到理论计算（第一性原理和ReaxFF分子动力学）的自动化捕获、整理、分析和传播，并支持数据包生成DOI用于出版物。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确说明具体的物理发现。核心内容是介绍了一个名为LiST的数据平台，该平台能够实现从实验合成参数、表征数据到理论计算（第一性原理和ReaxFF分子动力学）的自动化捕获、整理、分析和传播，并支持数据包生成DOI用于出版物。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与传统数据管理方式相比的具体创新点。主要贡献在于为2DCC-MIP设施开发了一个集成的、自动化的、支持闭环迭代（合成-表征-理论-设计）的数据平台，并已推广至外部用户，为机器学习、人工智能分析和未来自主合成提供了数据基础。
papers.method_zh: 平台本身集成了多种方法的数据管理：实验方面涵盖块体晶体生长、金属有机化学气相沉积（MOCVD）、分子束外延（MBE）等；理论方面包括第一性原理计算和ReaxFF分子动力学建模。数据通过REST API访问。

papers.title: Coexistence of Donor and Acceptor Hydrogen States in n-Type InN
papers.abstract: Hydrogen often exhibits amphoteric behavior in semiconductors, but its role is in n-type InN remains unresolved. Wurtzite InN is a narrow-gap semiconductor with high electron mobility and is therefore attractive for high-speed electronics and optoelectronic applications. Here we use hard x-ray photoemission spectroscopy (HAXPES) to probe hydrogen-related electronic structure in as-grown and post-annealed InN thin films prepared at different grown temperatures. Post annealing, which reduces the concentration of hydrogen impurities in the films, shifts the core-level spectra toward lower binding energy, consistent with a chemical-potential shift associated with the passivation of electron carriers. In the valence-band spectra, an acceptor-like in-gap feature near the valence-band maximum is suppressed after annealing. Together with the established donor-like behavior of hydrogen in InN, these results suggest that acceptor H- states coexist with donor H+ states in InN. The coexistence of these opposite hydrogen charge states provides a microscopic picture of hydrogen-driven compensation in InN and highlights the amphoteric nature of hydrogen even in a highly n-type semiconductor.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：使用硬X射线光电子能谱（HAXPES）进行实验测量，涉及样品制备（不同生长温度下的InN薄膜）及退火处理。；研究对象：n型氮化铟（InN）中氢杂质的电荷态行为，具体研究氢在n型InN中同时作为施主和受主的双性行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在n型InN中，氢不仅表现出已知的施主（H⁺）行为，还同时存在受主（H⁻）态，两者共存导致氢对载流子的补偿效应，揭示了氢在高度n型半导体中的双性本质。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在n型InN中，氢不仅表现出已知的施主（H⁺）行为，还同时存在受主（H⁻）态，两者共存导致氢对载流子的补偿效应，揭示了氢在高度n型半导体中的双性本质。；创新点：首次通过实验证据表明在高度n型的InN中，氢的受主态（H⁻）与施主态（H⁺）共存，从而为氢驱动的补偿机制提供了微观图像，澄清了此前关于氢在n型InN中角色未解决的争议。
papers.method_zh: 硬X射线光电子能谱（HAXPES），结合不同生长温度制备的InN薄膜以及退火处理（降低氢杂质浓度），通过分析芯能级谱和价带谱的化学位移及带隙内特征变化来推断氢的电荷态。

papers.title: Surface-switchable nonreciprocity protected by Fermi arcs in Weyl semimetal TaAs
papers.abstract: Weyl semimetals host topologically protected surface states, known as Fermi arcs, which connect bulk Weyl nodes in momentum space. Both bulk Weyl nodes and Fermi arcs are anticipated to be chiral. The chirality of bulk bands has been confirmed through observations of the chiral anomaly and Weyl orbits. In contrast, despite their discovery more than a decade ago, the chiral nature of Fermi arcs has remained unresolved. Here we report Fermi-arc-induced nonlinear transport in the archetypal Weyl semimetal TaAs. Using focused ion beam techniques, we fabricated micro-scale devices that enable simultaneous transport measurements on opposing topological surfaces. While linear transport remains dominated by bulk conduction, nonlinear transport uncovers surface-specific contributions, including an exceptionally large third-order nonreciprocal response that exceeds conventional expectations and highlights the crucial role of the singular arc endpoints. Our findings unambiguously demonstrate the chiral nature of Fermi arcs and establish nonlinear transport as a direct probe of these topological surface states. By revealing a surface-switchable, room-temperature nonlinear response that is topologically protected, this work introduces a new functionality in Weyl semimetals. Given the abundance of natural materials predicted to host topological semimetal states, these results open opportunities for exploring nonlinear transport phenomena and device concepts across a broad class of systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：fabricated micro-scale devices、transport measurements、focused ion beam techniques。；研究对象：Weyl半金属TaAs中的拓扑表面态（Fermi arcs）及其手性，以及由此产生的非线性输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实验证实了Weyl半金属TaAs中Fermi arcs的手性本质，并发现其能产生超大且可表面切换的三阶非互易非线性响应，该响应受拓扑保护且可在室温下工作。
