papers.abstract: We investigate the thermal partition and one-point functions of the three-dimensional conformal field theory dual to a massive interacting scalar field in AdS$_4$. Using thermal inversion formulas, we determine the asymptotic behaviour of the spectral density and OPE coefficients involving heavy operators at fixed spin. We first analyse these CFT data for the generalised free field, corresponding to the non-interacting bulk theory. Then we compute the first-order perturbative corrections induced by the cubic and quartic bulk interactions. The thermal observables considered here probe a sector associated with operators of large dimension and, in the bulk description, a regime dominated by states with large particle number. This regime remains comparatively unexplored even in generalised free field theory. Remarkably, the asymptotic formulas obtained from thermal inversion remain quantitatively accurate far from the asymptotic regime, describing CFT data reliably already at intermediate conformal weights. Our results show that this feature survives the inclusion of bulk interactions and provide new analytic control over heavy-state data in conformal field theories.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“thermal inversion formulas”“perturbative corrections”等理论分析工具，研究AdS/CFT对偶中的热力学和OPE系数，无实验或计算模拟内容。；研究对象：三维共形场论（CFT₃）的热配分函数和单点函数，该CFT对偶于AdS₄中的有质量相互作用标量场。具体研究涉及大维度算符（heavy operators）的谱密度和OPE系数。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过热反演公式得到的渐近公式在远离渐近区域时仍保持定量准确，能在中等共形权重下可靠描述CFT数据，且该特征在加入体相互作用（三次和四次耦合）后依然成立。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过热反演公式得到的渐近公式在远离渐近区域时仍保持定量准确，能在中等共形权重下可靠描述CFT数据，且该特征在加入体相互作用（三次和四次耦合）后依然成立。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断：该工作首次在包含体相互作用的背景下，系统验证了热反演公式在非渐近区域的定量准确性，从而为共形场论中重态数据提供了新的解析控制手段。
papers.method_zh: 使用热反演公式（thermal inversion formulas）分析谱密度和OPE系数的渐近行为；先对广义自由场（对应无相互作用的体理论）进行分析，再计算三次和四次体相互作用的一阶微扰修正。

papers.title: The Helical SYK Model and Emergent Infrared Integrability
papers.abstract: We construct a helical generalization of the Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) model in $1+1$ dimensions, built from left- and right-moving Majorana fermions with local quartic interactions and random couplings in flavor-chirality space. These interactions organize into a symmetry-controlled hierarchy of quartic chirality sectors. At the most restrictive end of this hierarchy, symmetry forces the quartic structure into a density-density form, which admits an exact solution using bosonization, rendering the theory integrable. Once the full quartic helical interaction space is allowed, including purely chiral, chirality-balanced, and chirality-imbalanced sectors, this symmetry-protected integrable structure is lost. Nevertheless, the large-$N$ infrared limit remains analytically tractable through short-distance selection rules and disorder averaging. Using conformal perturbation theory about the free fixed point, we show that the entire interaction space is marginally irrelevant, and the theory thus becomes free and integrable in the IR.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“bosonization”“conformal perturbation theory”“large-N infrared limit”等理论方法，无实验或计算模拟描述。；研究对象：1+1维螺旋SYK模型（Helical SYK Model），由左移和右移马约拉纳费米子构成，具有局域四次相互作用和味-手征空间随机耦合。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在对称性限制下，四次相互作用可简化为密度-密度形式，通过玻色化精确求解，理论可积；当允许全部四次螺旋相互作用空间时，可积结构丧失，但在大N红外极限下，通过短距离选择规则和无序平均仍可解析处理，且整个相互作用空间在红外是边缘无关的，理论最终变为自由可积。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在对称性限制下，四次相互作用可简化为密度-密度形式，通过玻色化精确求解，理论可积；当允许全部四次螺旋相互作用空间时，可积结构丧失，但在大N红外极限下，通过短距离选择规则和无序平均仍可解析处理，且整个相互作用空间在红外是边缘无关的，理论最终变为自由可积。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 玻色化（bosonization）、共形微扰论（conformal perturbation theory）、大N极限分析、短距离选择规则与无序平均。

papers.title: Fermionic Hamiltonian engineering with local control
papers.abstract: Quantum simulators enable the exploration of complex quantum phenomena in condensed-matter systems by reproducing their dynamics on controllable quantum devices. However, experimental constraints often restrict the class of Hamiltonians that can be realized natively. Hamiltonian engineering addresses this limitation by expanding the set of accessible target Hamiltonians from a fixed system Hamiltonian defined by the hardware. We introduce a new framework for fermionic Hamiltonian engineering based on conjugating free evolution under the system Hamiltonian with sequences of experimentally feasible local fermionic unitaries. The required sequences and free-evolution times are obtained efficiently via a linear program. By interleaving system evolution with these local unitaries, our method realizes effective time evolution under a broad class of target Hamiltonians, with intrinsic robustness to finite-pulse-time errors. In particular, we demonstrate that arbitrary complex tunnelling coefficients can be realized, constrained only by the connectivity of the underlying system Hamiltonian. We illustrate this capability by engineering the dynamics of the non-interacting Harper-Hofstadter model on a 1088-mode lattice and an interacting Fermi-Hubbard chain with complex tunnelling coefficients. By construction, our approach avoids the continuous energy absorption inherent to Floquet engineering.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：framework、linear program、engineering。；研究对象：费米子量子模拟器中的哈密顿量工程，具体涉及非相互作用的Harper-Hofstadter模型和相互作用的Fermi-Hubbard链。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种基于局域费米子幺正变换的哈密顿量工程框架，能够实现任意复数隧穿系数，且对有限脉冲时间误差具有内在鲁棒性，同时避免了Floquet工程中固有的连续能量吸收。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种基于局域费米子幺正变换的哈密顿量工程框架，能够实现任意复数隧穿系数，且对有限脉冲时间误差具有内在鲁棒性，同时避免了Floquet工程中固有的连续能量吸收。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过将系统哈密顿量下的自由演化与实验上可行的局域费米子幺正序列进行共轭操作，利用线性规划高效求解所需序列和自由演化时间，从而实现对目标哈密顿量的有效时间演化。

papers.title: Projected logical ensembles in surface codes via the random-matrix theory of quantum dots
papers.abstract: Measurements underpin active quantum error correction (QEC) and have been recognized as a source of novel measurement-induced many-body phenomena. Here, we study the statistical properties of post-measurement logical states arising in QEC on topological codes subject to deterministic transversal unitary gates. Upon syndrome extraction followed by maximum-likelihood decoding, a Born-weighted ensemble arises which we dub the "projected logical ensemble" (PLE). Focusing on surface codes subject to uniform single-qubit Pauli-$X$ rotations, we characterize the measurement-induced randomness of the PLE. To this end, we show that for a code with a single logical qubit, the PLE is isomorphic to an ensemble of scattering matrices describing mesoscopic quantum dots obtained from a 2D Majorana network model with suitable boundary conditions. We uncover regimes where these quantum dots are chaotic such that their scattering matrices are well-described by random matrix theory. In these regimes, the PLE approaches a universal ensemble that is maximally random up to symmetry and decoder-induced constraints. The symmetry constraints, set by stabilizer and logical operator weights, realize Altland-Zirnbauer classes D or DIII, which we both illustrate. Our results establish a fundamental connection between emergent universality concepts in mesoscopic physics, quantum many-body systems, and QEC.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据关键词：study, show, uncover, establish connection, random matrix theory。；研究对象：拓扑量子纠错码（表面码）中，在确定性横向幺正门作用下，通过纠错测量产生的后测量逻辑态统计性质，具体称为“投影逻辑系综”（PLE）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 表面码的投影逻辑系综与二维马约拉纳网络模型描述的介观量子点散射矩阵系综同构；在混沌区域，该系综由随机矩阵理论描述，并实现Altland-Zirnbauer D类或DIII类普适系综。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：表面码的投影逻辑系综与二维马约拉纳网络模型描述的介观量子点散射矩阵系综同构；在混沌区域，该系综由随机矩阵理论描述，并实现Altland-Zirnbauer D类或DIII类普适系综。；创新点：建立了介观物理中随机矩阵普适性、量子多体系统与量子纠错码中投影逻辑系综之间的基本联系，揭示了纠错测量诱导的统计系综在对称性约束下可达到最大随机性。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：利用随机矩阵理论，将表面码的投影逻辑系综映射为具有特定边界条件的二维马约拉纳网络模型中的散射矩阵系综，并分析其对称性约束（由稳定子与逻辑算符权重决定）。

papers.title: Directing Open-Ended Evolution in Artificial Life via Multi-Scale Path Divergence
papers.abstract: Open-ended evolution (OEE) in artificial life is typically driven by uninterpretable, black-box neural-network complexity metrics, leaving life-like systems disconnected from physical theories of complexity. We introduce MSPD (Multi-Scale Path Divergence, denoted DP ), a renormalization-group-inspired scalar that quantifies the temporal multiscale organization of heterogeneity in local transition laws. MSPD is defined at the population level as a functional of the realised trajectory and is computed as a windowed finite-resolution estimator, with consistency between the two stated as a proposition. The metric is an explicit formula and plays a dual role: as a gradient-free fitness function and as a post-hoc analytical lens on any simulation that exposes local transition laws. Empirically, MSPD-optimized parameters produce higher held-out complexity scores than matched random parameters from the same substrate. High-$H_{Delta_t}$ states correspond to states with higher instability to external interventions, so the metric tracks the biology of the underlying dynamics rather than noise. Higher MSPD corresponds to stronger scale-dependent frustration: high-complexity systems exhibit larger differences between the dynamics expressed at different spatial extents, linking MSPD directly to the frustration criterion of biological complexity in the sense of Vanchurin et al. [ 23 ]. The same protocol transfers beyond the primary Flow-Lenia substrate to Life-like cellular automata and Particle Life++, where C1, C2 and C5 all hold. A single explicit formula thus both directs open-ended evolution and provides a principled bridge to the physics of complexity that black-box drivers do not.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：renormalization-group-inspired scalar、explicit formula、gradient-free fitness function、post-hoc analytical lens。；研究对象：人工生命（Artificial Life）系统中的开放式演化（Open-Ended Evolution, OEE），具体包括Flow-Lenia、Life-like细胞自动机和Particle Life++等数字生命基质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种受重正化群启发的标量指标——多尺度路径散度（MSPD，记为DP），它能够量化局部跃迁规律在时间多尺度上的异质性组织，既可作为无梯度适应度函数引导开放式演化，又可作为事后分析工具揭示底层动力学，且其高值对应更强的尺度依赖阻挫，与Vanchurin等人提出的生物复杂性阻挫判据直接关联。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种受重正化群启发的标量指标——多尺度路径散度（MSPD，记为DP），它能够量化局部跃迁规律在时间多尺度上的异质性组织，既可作为无梯度适应度函数引导开放式演化，又可作为事后分析工具揭示底层动力学，且其高值对应更强的尺度依赖阻挫，与Vanchurin等人提出的生物复杂性阻挫判据直接关联。；创新点：首次提出一个显式解析公式（而非黑箱神经网络复杂度指标）来驱动开放式演化，并建立与物理学复杂性理论（重正化群、阻挫判据）之间的原理性桥梁。摘要未突出说明与已有黑箱方法的具体性能对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与数值模拟相结合。MSPD定义为群体层面轨迹泛函，通过窗口化有限分辨率估计器计算；在Flow-Lenia、Life-like细胞自动机和Particle Life++等基质上，将MSPD作为适应度函数进行参数优化，并与随机参数对比，同时检验其作为事后分析工具的有效性。

papers.title: Impulsive Hydrodynamic Exfoliation into Monolayer Graphene and Nanofragments by Transonic Flow Focusing
papers.abstract: We propose using Transonic Flow Focusing (TFF) to produce 2D and 0D nanomaterials. This technique focuses liquid suspensions into high-speed micrometer-scale jets, combining extremely high shear and elongational stresses in a confined, contact-free zone. For the Graphene Nanoplatelets suspensions and TFF operating conditions investigated here, the process promoted exfoliation without added surfactants or oxidative chemistry. Both graphene monolayer flakes ($\sim 300-400$ nm in lateral size) and monolayer graphene nanofragments with lateral sizes compatible with quantum dots ($\sim 10-15$ nm) were obtained in a single TFF step using isopropanol and pure water. Our theoretical analysis reveals that, during microsecond residence times at the meniscus-jet transition, shear and extensional stresses of the order of $10^6$ s$^{-1}$ act on the suspended particles, yielding viscous power densities of the order of $10^{10}$ $\mathrm{W/m^{3}}$. High-resolution transmission electron microscopy and atomic force microscopy show that the monolayer fraction exceeded 99\% for isopropanol and 92.9\% for water. These results suggest that TFF can combine solvent versatility with a high monolayer fraction in a purely mechanical top-down process.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（判断依据：摘要描述了具体实验过程、表征手段如HRTEM、AFM，并给出了定量实验结果）；研究对象：石墨烯纳米片悬浮液在瞬态流聚焦（TFF）作用下剥离产生的单层石墨烯及纳米碎片（0D和2D纳米材料）
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过瞬态流聚焦（TFF）技术，在无表面活性剂或氧化化学条件下，一步实现石墨烯纳米片的高效剥离，获得横向尺寸约300-400 nm的单层石墨烯微片和约10-15 nm的单层石墨烯纳米碎片，且单层比例超过99%（异丙醇中）或92.9%（水中）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过瞬态流聚焦（TFF）技术，在无表面活性剂或氧化化学条件下，一步实现石墨烯纳米片的高效剥离，获得横向尺寸约300-400 nm的单层石墨烯微片和约10-15 nm的单层石墨烯纳米碎片，且单层比例超过99%（异丙醇中）或92.9%（水中）。；创新点：提出并验证了TFF作为一种纯机械、自上而下的方法，可在不同溶剂（异丙醇和纯水）中实现高单层产率的石墨烯剥离，同时能直接获得与量子点尺寸兼容的单层纳米碎片，无需添加表面活性剂或氧化处理。
papers.method_zh: 瞬态流聚焦（TFF）技术（利用高速微米级射流产生高剪切和拉伸应力）；高分辨率透射电子显微镜（HRTEM）和原子力显微镜（AFM）用于表征产物形貌与层数；理论分析用于估算应力（约10^6 s^{-1}）和粘性功率密度（约10^{10} W/m^3）。

papers.title: A Fixed Representation Probe Reveals Morphology-Space Organization in Non-Gaussian Elastic Transients
papers.abstract: Elastic systems driven by intermittent energy release generate non-Gaussian transients across domains such as brittle fracture, seismicity, rotating machinery and interferometric instrumentation. These signals often contain bursts, ringdowns, ridges and clustered energy packets, but it remains unclear whether such motifs define a measurable morphology comparable across physical systems. Here we use a frozen convolutional encoder trained on transient-rich interferometric noise as a fixed probe of non-Gaussian elastic morphology. The encoder is not fine-tuned, retrained or recalibrated on any target domain. Signals are mapped to a common time-frequency representation and compared through latent geometry and perturbation response rather than task-specific classification. In granite acoustic-emission experiments, L2-normalized embeddings define trajectories on a latent hypersphere. The cumulative angular path provides a derivative-free observable of morphological reorganization. This geometry distinguishes two fracture organizations: a more distributed damage evolution and a more localized rupture regime. The localized regime accumulates a larger angular path and degrades more strongly under phase randomization and temporal-order perturbation, consistent with a more phase-sensitive and sequence-dependent rupture morphology. Synthetic controls and seismic morphology-destruction experiments indicate that the response is not explained by marginal spectral energy alone, while random-weight attribution controls show that visual localization is insufficient without quantitative perturbation tests. These results support frozen transient-rich representations as fixed measurement probes for comparing non-Gaussian elastic morphology across heterogeneous physical systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与计算分析结合）。判断依据：实验（granite acoustic-emission experiments）、计算分析（frozen convolutional encoder、latent geometry、perturbation response）。；研究对象：非高斯弹性瞬态信号，具体包括脆性断裂、地震活动、旋转机械和干涉测量仪器中的弹性瞬态，以及花岗岩声发射实验中的断裂组织形态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过固定探针（frozen convolutional encoder）将不同物理系统的非高斯弹性瞬态信号映射到共同的时间-频率表示和潜在几何空间中，发现局部化断裂形态比分布式损伤演化具有更大的累积角路径，且对相位随机化和时间顺序扰动更敏感，表明瞬态形态具有可测量的、跨系统可比较的组织结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过固定探针（frozen convolutional encoder）将不同物理系统的非高斯弹性瞬态信号映射到共同的时间-频率表示和潜在几何空间中，发现局部化断裂形态比分布式损伤演化具有更大的累积角路径，且对相位随机化和时间顺序扰动更敏感，表明瞬态形态具有可测量的、跨系统可比较的组织结构。；创新点：提出一种无需微调或重训练的固定表示探针方法，用于跨不同物理系统比较非高斯弹性瞬态的形态学组织，并通过累积角路径和扰动响应提供了可量化的形态重组观测指标，超越了传统的边际谱能量分析。
papers.method_zh: 使用在瞬态丰富的干涉噪声上预训练的固定卷积编码器（frozen convolutional encoder）作为探针，不对目标域进行微调或重训练。信号被映射到共同的时间-频率表示，通过潜在几何（L2归一化嵌入在潜在超球面上的轨迹）和扰动响应（相位随机化、时间顺序扰动）进行比较，而非任务特定分类。实验数据来自花岗岩声发射实验。
